items.detail: Real-time vision demands models that are accurate, efficient, and simple to deploy across diverse hardware. The YOLO family has become widely deployed for this reason, yet most YOLO detectors still rely on non-maximum suppression at inference, carry heavy detection heads due to Distribution Focal Loss, require long training schedules, and can leave the smallest objects without positive label assignments. We present Ultralytics YOLO26, a unified real-time vision model family that addresses these limitations through coordinated architecture and training advances. YOLO26 uses a dual-head design for native NMS-free end-to-end inference and removes DFL entirely, yielding a lighter head with unconstrained regression range. Its training pipeline combines MuSGD, a hybrid Muon-SGD optimizer adapted from large language model training; Progressive Loss, which shifts supervision toward the inference-time head; and STAL, a label assignment strategy that guarantees positive coverage for small objects. Beyond detection, YOLO26 introduces task-specific head and loss designs for instance segmentation, pose estimation, and oriented detection, producing consistent gains across tasks and scales. The family spans five scales (n/s/m/l/x) and supports detection, instance segmentation, pose estimation, classification, and oriented detection in a single pipeline, with an open-vocabulary extension, YOLOE-26, for text-, visual-, and prompt-free inference. Across all scales, YOLO26 achieves 40.9-57.5 mAP on COCO at 1.7-11.8 ms T4 TensorRT latency, advancing the accuracy-latency Pareto front over prior real-time detectors, while YOLOE-26x reaches 40.6 AP on LVIS minival under text prompting. Code and models are available at https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics.
items.title_zh: 超解YOLO26：统一实时端对端视野模型
items.detail_zh: 实时视觉需要准确，高效，简便的模型，以在各种硬件中部署。 YOLO家族因此被广泛部署，然而大多数YOLO探测器在推论上仍然依赖非最大压制，由于分布焦距损失而携带重探测头，需要较长的训练时间表，可以让最小的物体没有正面的标签任务。我们介绍Ultralytics YOLO26，这是一个统一的实时视野模型家族，通过协调的建筑和培训进步来克服这些局限性。 YOLO26为本土NMS无端对端推论使用双头设计，并完全去除DFL，产生一个没有约束的回归范围的较轻头。其培训管道结合了MuSGD这一混合的Muon-SGD优化器，根据大型语言模式培训加以调整；进步损失，将监督转向推论时间头；和STAL，一种标签分配策略，它保证对小物体的正面覆盖。除检测外，YOLO26还引入了特定任务头和损失设计，例如分解，提出估计和定向检测，在任务和尺度之间产生一致的收益。家族跨越5个尺度(n/s/m/l/x)，支持检测，实例分解，在单一的管道中提出估计，分类，并定向检测，并带有开放式的vocabulary扩展，YOLOE-26，用于文本，视觉，以及即时的免费推断。在所有尺度上，YOLO26在COCO上以1.7至11.8 ms T4 TensorRT的耐久性达到40.9至57.5 mAP，将精度-常帕雷托正面推进到之前的实时探测器上，而YOLOE-26x在文字提示下在LVIS小val上达到40.6 AP。代码和模型见https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics。

items.detail: Full-duplex spoken dialogue systems significantly advance over traditional turn-based dialogue systems, as they allow simultaneous bidirectional communication, closely mirroring human-human interactions. However, achieving low latency and natural interactions in full-duplex dialogue systems remains a significant challenge, especially considering human conversation dynamics such as interruptions, backchannels, and overlapping speech. In this paper, we introduce a novel End-to-End GPT-based model OmniFlatten for full-duplex conversation, capable of effectively modeling the complex behaviors inherent to natural conversations with low latency. To achieve full-duplex communication capabilities, we propose a multi-stage post-training scheme that progressively adapts a text-based large language model (LLM) backbone into a speech-text dialogue LLM, capable of generating text and speech in real time, without modifying the architecture of the backbone LLM. The training process comprises three stages: modality alignment, half-duplex dialogue learning, and full-duplex dialogue learning. Throughout all training stages, we standardize the data using a flattening operation, which allows us to unify the training methods and the model architecture across different modalities and tasks. Our approach offers a straightforward modeling technique and a promising research direction for developing efficient and natural end-to-end full-duplex spoken dialogue systems. Audio samples of dialogues generated by OmniFlatten can be found at this web site (https://omniflatten.github.io/).
items.title_zh: OmniFlatten：无缝语音对话的端对端GPT模型
items.detail_zh: 完全繁复的口语对话系统比传统的回合式对话系统大有进步，因为它们可以同时进行双向交流，密切地反映人与人之间的互动。然而，在全复式对话系统中实现低延迟和自然互动仍然是一个重大挑战，特别是考虑到人的对话动态，如中断、后通道和重叠的言论。在本文中，我们引入了以端对端GPT为基础的小说模型OmniFlatten，用于全复式对话，能够有效模拟低纬度的自然对话所固有的复杂行为。为了实现全方位的交流能力，我们提出一个多阶段的后培训计划，将基于文本的大型语言模型(LLM)主干逐步改编为语音-文本对话LLM，能够实时生成文本和语音，而不修改主干LLM的结构。培训过程包括三个阶段：模式调整、半复式对话学习和全复式对话学习。在所有培训阶段，我们使用一个平整操作使数据标准化，使我们能够统一不同模式和任务的训练方法和示范结构。我们的方法为发展高效的、自然的、端到端的完全复杂的口语对话系统提供了直接的建模技术和有希望的研究方向。在该网站(https://omniflatten.github.io/)可以找到OmniFlatten生成的对话框的音频样本。

items.title: VoxMel TTS Technical Report
items.subtitle: Continuous autoregressive TTS relies on an acoustic target that enables stable next-latent modeling while preserving fine-grained acoustic details. While existing approaches employ learned compressed representations (e.g., continuous VAE latents) to render prediction tractable, they rely on complex neural encoders that often cap generation fidelity. Conversely, training-free targets like mel-spectrograms eliminate encoder overhead, yet their potential for autoregressive generation remains largely underexplored. items.detail: Continuous autoregressive TTS relies on an acoustic target that enables stable next-latent modeling while preserving fine-grained acoustic details. While existing approaches employ learned compressed representations (e.g., continuous VAE latents) to render prediction tractable, they rely on complex neural encoders that often cap generation fidelity. Conversely, training-free targets like mel-spectrograms eliminate encoder overhead, yet their potential for autoregressive generation remains largely underexplored. In this work, we propose VoxMel, a tokenizer-free framework for autoregressive TTS that makes stable mel modeling tractable through a fixed, exactly invertible two-axis Haar transform. The transform first decomposes each mel spectrogram along frequency into local averages and a frequency residual, then splits the averaged component along time into Coarse-Mel and a temporal residual. A language-model backbone with a flow-matching head autoregressively generates Coarse-Mel. Non-autoregressive residual tiers then predict the temporal residual from Coarse-Mel, followed by the frequency residual conditioned on the reconstructed Frequency-Averaged Mel. Neither residual is fed back into the autoregressive history. Trained on 100K hours of Emilia, the supervised 0.6B model obtains 1.51\% WER and 0.738 speaker similarity (SIM) on test-en, and 1.29\% CER and 0.755 SIM on test-zh. GRPO improves these results to 1.15\% WER / 0.753 SIM and 1.17\% CER / 0.776 SIM, respectively. We also distill the guided flow head into two- and four-step students, requiring 2 or 4 head evaluations per coarse frame. The four-step student retains competitive SIM and nearly matches the supervised model in WER/CER.
items.detail_zh: 持续的自递式TTS依赖于一个声学目标，这个目标在保存精细纹理的声学细节的同时，能够实现稳定的近端建模。虽然现有方法利用学到的压缩表示(如连续的VAE潜伏物)使预测具有可拉动性，但它们依赖于复杂的神经编码器，这些编码器往往限制生成忠诚度。反之，无培训目标，如Mel-光谱仪，消除了编码器的间接费用，但其自动生成的潜力在很大程度上仍然没有得到充分利用。在这部作品中，我们提出VoxMel，一个自递式TTS的无标本框架，通过固定的，完全不可逆的两轴Haar变换，使稳定的mel模型可拉动。变换先将每个mel光谱沿频率分解成局部平均值和一个频率残基，然后将平均元件沿时间分解成粗毛-梅尔和一个时间残基。具有流配头自动递归性生成粗糙-梅尔的语言型骨干。非自动还原性残留级然后预测来自粗毛耳的时间残留，然后预测重建的频率-经测算的梅尔的频率残留条件。任何剩余部分都不会被反馈到自动倒退的历史中。在Emilia100K小时的训练中，被监督的0.6B型号在测试中获得了1.51QQWER和0.738扬声器相似度(SIM)，在测试中获得了1.29QCER和0.755SIM。 GRPO将这些结果分别改进为1.15++WER / 0.753 SIM和1.17+CER / 0.776 SIM。我们还将导流头蒸馏成两步和四步的学生，每粗框需要2或4个头评价。四步学生保留有竞争力的SIM，并几乎与WER/CER中的受监督模式相匹配。

items.detail: We introduce Zep, a novel memory layer service for AI agents that outperforms the current state-of-the-art system, MemGPT, in the Deep Memory Retrieval (DMR) benchmark. Additionally, Zep excels in more comprehensive and challenging evaluations than DMR that better reflect real-world enterprise use cases. While existing retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) frameworks for large language model (LLM)-based agents are limited to static document retrieval, enterprise applications demand dynamic knowledge integration from diverse sources including ongoing conversations and business data. Zep addresses this fundamental limitation through its core component Graphiti -- a temporally-aware knowledge graph engine that dynamically synthesizes both unstructured conversational data and structured business data while maintaining historical relationships. In the DMR benchmark, which the MemGPT team established as their primary evaluation metric, Zep demonstrates superior performance (94.8% vs 93.4%). Beyond DMR, Zep's capabilities are further validated through the more challenging LongMemEval benchmark, which better reflects enterprise use cases through complex temporal reasoning tasks. In this evaluation, Zep achieves substantial results with accuracy improvements of up to 18.5% while simultaneously reducing response latency by 90% compared to baseline implementations. These results are particularly pronounced in enterprise-critical tasks such as cross-session information synthesis and long-term context maintenance, demonstrating Zep's effectiveness for deployment in real-world applications.
items.title_zh: Zep：代理内存的时空知识图架构
items.detail_zh: 我们引入了Zep，这是AI代理的新记忆层服务，在深记忆检索(DMR)基准中，它的表现超过了目前最先进的系统MemGPT。此外，Zep在比DMR更全面和更具挑战性的评价方面表现优异，能够更好地反映现实世界的企业使用案例。虽然基于大语言模型(LLM)的代理商的现有检索-增强生成(RAG)框架仅限于静态文件检索，但企业应用程序需要从不同来源，包括正在进行的对话和业务数据，进行动态知识整合。 Zep通过它的核心成分Graphiti来解决这一根本的局限性——一种时间意识的知识图引擎，在保持历史关系的同时，动态地合成非结构的对话数据和结构化的商业数据。在作为主要评价指标的多指标类集调查小组制定的DMR基准中，Zep显示业绩优异(94.8%对93.4%)。除了DMR，泽普的能力通过更具挑战性的LongMemEval基准进一步验证，通过复杂的时间推理任务更好地反映企业的使用案例。在本次评价中，泽普取得了实质性成果，精度提高高达18.5%，同时与基线实施相比，反应延迟度降低了90%。这些成果在跨会间信息综合和长期上下文维护等企业关键任务中尤为突出，显示出泽普在现实世界应用中的部署效果。

items.detail: We present WeMM-Ecom, a family of multimodal large language models that deliver frontier e-commerce capabilities while achieving state-of-the-art general-purpose performance at their respective scales. The family spans five sizes, from a 0.8B dense model to a 35B mixture-of-experts model with 3B active parameters. Our training pipeline begins with two-stage continued pre-training that progressively raises the proportion of e-commerce data within a diverse multimodal data mixture, followed by hybrid-thinking post-training that combines on-policy distillation and reinforcement learning to support both non-thinking and thinking modes. For evaluation, we construct a comprehensive suite of 28 e-commerce benchmarks (23 in-house and five open-source) covering eight business scenarios and complement it with 64 public general-purpose benchmarks. On the e-commerce suite, WeMM-Ecom-35B-A3B surpasses substantially larger open-source flagship models, including Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, HY4, and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash. On the general-purpose suite, every WeMM-Ecom model surpasses its similarly sized Qwen3.5 counterpart, with the lightweight variants (e.g., WeMM-Ecom-2B) showing clear advantages over leading lightweight models such as Qwen3.5-2B, MiniCPM-V-4.7-1B, and LFM3-VL-2B. Beyond benchmarks, WeMM-Ecom now powers hundreds of production use cases in WeChat, including catalog management, multimodal product search, and livestream commerce, serving billion-scale requests per day. We publicly release all model weights and detail our data curation, training recipe, and benchmark construction to facilitate future work on domain-specialized multimodal models. We have released the model weights and code to facilitate future research at https://github.com/Tencent/WeMM-Ecom.
items.title_zh: WeMM-Ecom：推进微信电子商务多式联运内容理解。
items.detail_zh: 我们介绍WemM-Ecom，这是一个由多种大型语言模式组成的大家庭，它们提供前沿电子商务能力，同时在各自规模上实现最新通用性能。家族有5个大小，从0.8B稠密模型到35B混合专家模型并有3B活性参数。我们的培训管道首先分两个阶段持续进行前培训，逐步提高电子商务数据在多种多模式数据混合物中的比例，然后进行混合思考后培训，将政策提炼和强化学习结合起来，以支持非思维和思维模式。为了进行评价，我们建造了一套全面的28个电子商务基准(23个内部基准和5个开放源码)，涵盖8个业务设想，并以64个公共通用基准加以补充。在电子商务套装上，WEMM-Ecom-35B-A3B超越了相当大的开源旗舰模式，包括Qune3.8-Flash-Next，HY4和DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash。在通用套件上，每个WemMM-Ecom模型都超过了其类似大小的Quen3.5对应器，轻量级变体(如WemM-Ecom-2B)显示出明显优于领先的轻量级模型，如Quen3.5-2B，MiniCPM-V-4.7-1B和LFM3-VL-2B等。除了基准之外，WemM-Ecom现在还授权WeChat中数百个生产使用案例，包括目录管理、多模式产品搜索和活流商业，每天满足十亿级的要求。我们公开发布所有模型权重，详细介绍我们的数据解析、培训秘方和基准构建，以利未来关于域内专用多模式模式的工作。我们发布了模型加权和代码，以便于今后在https://github.com/Tencent/WemM-Ecom进行研究。

items.title: LongCat-Video Technical Report
items.subtitle: Video generation is a critical pathway toward world models, with efficient long video inference as a key capability. Toward this end, we introduce LongCat-Video, a foundational video generation model with 13.6B parameters, delivering strong performance across multiple video generation tasks. It particularly excels in efficient and high-quality long video generation, representing our first step toward world models. Key features include: Unified architecture for multiple tasks: Built on the Diffusion Transformer (DiT) framework, LongCat-Video supports Text-to-Video, Image-to-Video, and Video-Continuation tasks with a single model; Long video generation: Pretraining on Video-Continuation tasks
items.detail: Video generation is a critical pathway toward world models, with efficient long video inference as a key capability. Toward this end, we introduce LongCat-Video, a foundational video generation model with 13.6B parameters, delivering strong performance across multiple video generation tasks. It particularly excels in efficient and high-quality long video generation, representing our first step toward world models. Key features include: Unified architecture for multiple tasks: Built on the Diffusion Transformer (DiT) framework, LongCat-Video supports Text-to-Video, Image-to-Video, and Video-Continuation tasks with a single model; Long video generation: Pretraining on Video-Continuation tasks enables LongCat-Video to maintain high quality and temporal coherence in the generation of minutes-long videos; Efficient inference: LongCat-Video generates 720p, 30fps videos within minutes by employing a coarse-to-fine generation strategy along both the temporal and spatial axes. Block Sparse Attention further enhances efficiency, particularly at high resolutions; Strong performance with multi-reward RLHF: Multi-reward RLHF training enables LongCat-Video to achieve performance on par with the latest closed-source and leading open-source models. Code and model weights are publicly available to accelerate progress in the field.
items.detail_zh: 视频生成是走向世界模型的关键途径，以高效的长视频推论为关键能力。为此，我们引入了"长卡特-视频"(LongCat-Video)，这是一个具有13.6B参数的基础视频生成模型，在多个视频生成任务中展现出强效。它在高效和高质量的长相视频制作方面特别出色，代表了我们走向世界模式的第一步。主要功能包括：多个任务的统一架构：构建在分化变形器(DiT)框架上，LongCat-Video支持Text-to-Video，Image-Video，以及视频连续任务，采用单一模式；长视频生成：关于视频连续任务的预训，使LongCat-Video能够在生成分钟视频时保持高质量和时间上的一致性；高效推论：LongCat-Video在几分钟内通过在时间轴和空间轴上同时使用粗到fine生成策略生成720p，30fps视频。 Block Sparse Content进一步提高了效率，特别是在高分辨率下；强效多奖RLHF：多奖RLHF训练使LongCat-Video能够以与最新封闭源码和领先开源模式等同的方式实现性能。守则和模型权重已公开提供，以加速该领域的进展。

items.title: Native and Compact Structured Latents for 3D Generation

items.detail: Recent advancements in 3D generative modeling have significantly improved the generation realism, yet the field is still hampered by existing representations, which struggle to capture assets with complex topologies and detailed appearance. This paper present an approach for learning a structured latent representation from native 3D data to address this challenge. At its core is a new sparse voxel structure called O-Voxel, an omni-voxel representation that encodes both geometry and appearance. O-Voxel can robustly model arbitrary topology, including open, non-manifold, and fully-enclosed surfaces, while capturing comprehensive surface attributes beyond texture color, such as physically-based rendering parameters. Based on O-Voxel, we design a Sparse Compression VAE which provides a high spatial compression rate and a compact latent space. We train large-scale flow-matching models comprising 4B parameters for 3D generation using diverse public 3D asset datasets. Despite their scale, inference remains highly efficient. Meanwhile, the geometry and material quality of our generated assets far exceed those of existing models. We believe our approach offers a significant advancement in 3D generative modeling.
items.title_zh: 3D 世代的本地和契约结构的后人
items.detail_zh: 最近在3D基因模型化方面的进步大大改进了生成现实主义，然而这个领域仍然受到现有表述的阻碍，这些表述试图用复杂的地形和详细的外观来捕捉资产。本文件介绍了从本地立体数据中学习结构化潜在代表性以应对这一挑战的方法。其核心是一种新的稀疏的阴道结构，称为O-Voxel，是一种omni-voxel代表，它同时编码几何和外观。 O-Voxel可以强力地模拟任意地形，包括开放的，非狂形的，和完全封闭的表面，同时捕捉到超出纹理颜色的全面表面属性，如物理渲染参数。基于O-Voxel，我们设计了Sparse Compression VAE，提供高空间压缩率和紧凑的潜伏空间。我们利用不同的公共三维资产数据集，为三维生成培训由4B参数组成的大规模流量匹配模型。尽管其规模很大，但推断仍然非常有效。与此同时，我们创造的资产的几何和物质质量远远超过现有模型。我们认为，我们的做法在三维基因模型的制作方面取得重大进展。

items.detail: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has emerged as a fundamental paradigm for expanding Large Language Models beyond their static training limitations. However, a critical misalignment exists between current RAG capabilities and real-world information environments. Modern knowledge repositories are inherently multimodal, containing rich combinations of textual content, visual elements, structured tables, and mathematical expressions. Yet existing RAG frameworks are limited to textual content, creating fundamental gaps when processing multimodal documents. We present RAG-Anything, a unified framework that enables comprehensive knowledge retrieval across all modalities. Our approach reconceptualizes multimodal content as interconnected knowledge entities rather than isolated data types. The framework introduces dual-graph construction to capture both cross-modal relationships and textual semantics within a unified representation. We develop cross-modal hybrid retrieval that combines structural knowledge navigation with semantic matching. This enables effective reasoning over heterogeneous content where relevant evidence spans multiple modalities. RAG-Anything demonstrates superior performance on challenging multimodal benchmarks, achieving significant improvements over state-of-the-art methods. Performance gains become particularly pronounced on long documents where traditional approaches fail. Our framework establishes a new paradigm for multimodal knowledge access, eliminating the architectural fragmentation that constrains current systems. Our framework is open-sourced at: https://github.com/HKUDS/RAG-Anything.
items.title_zh: RAG-任何东西：全能的RAG框架
items.detail_zh: 检索-增强型一代(RAG)已成为超越其静态训练限制扩展大语言模型的基本范例。然而，目前的RAG能力和现实世界的信息环境之间存在严重的错位。现代知识库本质上是多模式的，包含丰富的文字内容组合，视觉元素，结构化的表格和数学表达。然而，现有的RAG框架仅限于文本内容，在处理多式文件时造成了根本的空白。我们提出 " RAG-Anything "，这是一个统一的框架，能够对所有模式进行全面的知识检索。我们的方法将多式联运内容重新定义为相互关联的知识实体，而不是孤立的数据类型。该框架引入了双图构建，在统一代表制内既抓住了跨模式关系，又抓住了文字语义。我们开发了将结构知识导航与语义匹配相结合的跨模式混合检索。在相关证据涉及多种模式的情况下，这样就能够对不同内容进行有效推理。 RAG-任何东西都显示出在挑战性多式联运基准方面的优异表现，比最先进的方法有了重大的改进。在传统办法失败的长文件中，业绩收益特别明显。我们的框架为获得多模式知识确立了新的范式，消除了制约现有系统的建筑分化。我们的框架开放来源于：https://github.com/HKUDS/RAG-Anything。

items.title: LlamaFactory: Unified Efficient Fine-Tuning of 100+ Language Models
items.subtitle: Efficient fine-tuning is vital for adapting large language models (LLMs) to downstream tasks. However, it requires non-trivial efforts to implement these methods on different models. We present LlamaFactory, a unified framework that integrates a suite of cutting-edge efficient training methods. It allows users to flexibly customize the fine-tuning of 100+ LLMs without the need for coding through the built-in web UI LlamaBoard. We empirically validate the efficiency and effectiveness of our framework on language modeling and text generation tasks. It has been released at https://github.com/hiyouga/LLaMA-Factory and already received over 13,000 stars and 1,600 forks.

items.title_zh: Llama Factory：100+语言模型的统一高效精细化
items.detail_zh: 有效的微调对于大型语言模型适应下游任务至关重要。然而，这需要非三角努力，在不同模式上实施这些方法。我们介绍LlamaFactory，这是一个统一框架，它整合了一套先进的高效培训方法。它允许用户灵活地自定义了100+LLMs的微调而无需通过内置的网络UI LlamaBoard进行编码。我们从经验上验证了我们关于语言建模和文本生成任务的框架的效率和成效。它已经在https://github.com/hiyouga/LLaMA-Factory上发布，已经收到了超过13000颗恒星和1600个叉。

items.title: SkillOpt: Executive Strategy for Self-Evolving Agent Skills
items.subtitle: Agent skills today are hand-crafted, generated one-shot, or evolved through loosely controlled self-revision, none of which behaves like a deep-learning optimizer for the skill, and none of which reliably improves over its starting point under feedback. items.detail: Agent skills today are hand-crafted, generated one-shot, or evolved through loosely controlled self-revision, none of which behaves like a deep-learning optimizer for the skill, and none of which reliably improves over its starting point under feedback. We argue the skill should instead be trained as the external state of a frozen agent, with the same discipline that makes weight-space optimization reproducible. SkillOpt is, to our knowledge, the first systematic controllable text-space optimizer for agent skills: a separate optimizer model turns scored rollouts into bounded add/delete/replace edits on a single skill document, and an edit is accepted only when it strictly improves a held-out validation score. A textual learning-rate budget, rejected-edit buffer, and epoch-wise slow/meta update make skill training stable while adding zero inference-time model calls at deployment. Across six benchmarks, seven target models, and three execution harnesses (direct chat, Codex, Claude Code), SkillOpt is best or tied on all 52 evaluated (model, benchmark, harness) cells and beats every per-cell competitor among human, one-shot LLM, Trace2Skill, TextGrad, GEPA, and EvoSkill skills. On GPT-5.5 it lifts the average no-skill accuracy by +23.5 points in direct chat, by +24.8 inside the Codex agentic loop, and by +19.1 inside Claude Code. Transfer experiments further show that optimized skill artifacts retain value when moved across model scales, between Codex and Claude Code execution environments, and to a nearby math benchmark without further optimization.
items.title_zh: SkillOpt：自我发展代理技能执行战略
items.detail_zh: 今天的代理技能是手工制作的，产生一发一发，或者通过松散的自控自译自审而演化而来，这些自译自译自译的自译自出，都没有一个表现得像技能的深层学习优化器，也没有一个在反馈下可靠地改善了其起步点。我们主张技能应该作为冷冻剂的外在状态来训练，具有同样的学科，使得重量空间优化可以再生产。据我们所知，SkillOpt是代理技能的首个系统可控文本空间优化器：一个单独的优化器模型将分数滚出变成在单一技能文档上被绑定的添加/删除/替换编辑，而编辑只有在严格改进被搁置的验证分数时才被接受。文字学习率预算、拒绝编辑缓冲和划时代的慢/元更新使技能培训稳定，同时在部署时增加零推断时间模型呼叫。在6个基准、7个目标模型和3个执行工具(直接聊天、Codex、Claude Code)上，SkillOpt是最佳的或与所有52个被评价的细胞(模型、基准、取用)捆绑在一起，并击败了人类中每个细胞的每个竞争者、一发LLM、Trace2Skill、TextGrad、GEPA和EvoSkill技能。在GPT-5.5上，它通过直接聊天的+23.5分，Codex代理回路的+24.8分和Claude代码的+19.1分提高平均无技能精度。转移实验进一步显示，优化后的技能文物在跨模型尺度移动时，在Codex和克洛德代码执行环境之间，以及在不作进一步优化的情况下被保留到相邻的数学基准上，保留了价值。

items.detail: We study a new problem of preventing object penetration in interactive video world models. To understand how existing models handle this, we introduce NoPeBench, a benchmark that evaluates how world models respond to physical obstacles. Our evaluation reveals that none of the open-source models can reliably prevent such failures. Surprisingly, however, these models already encode the information needed to predict such violations. We find that the hidden states of diffusion transformers (DiTs) can predict whether a candidate action will penetrate an obstacle. Building on this, we introduce NoPeWorld, a lightweight framework that detects and prevents penetration. Specifically, we train a small prediction head on top of a frozen DiT's hidden states to read out if a candidate action is safe or not. Unsafe actions are then replaced with safe ones that best preserve the original intent. Despite its simplicity, NoPeWorld substantially reduces the physical violation rate, averaged over six video world models, from 74% to 16%. Remarkably, our method shows zero-shot generalization to open-domain imagery, third-person viewpoints, and moving obstacles. We publicly release our code, the NoPeBench benchmark, and model weights. Project Page: https://nopeworld.github.io .
items.title_zh: 非穿透性世界模式
items.detail_zh: 我们研究一个防止物体渗透到交互式视频世界模型中的新问题。为了了解现有模型是如何处理这个问题的，我们引入了NoPe Bench，这个基准用来评价世界模型如何应对物理障碍。我们的评价表明，开放源码模型中没有一个能够可靠地防止这种失败。然而，令人惊讶的是，这些模型已经编码了预测这种侵权行为所需的信息。我们发现隐藏的扩散变压器状态(DiTs)可以预测候选动作是否会穿透障碍。在此基础上，我们引入了NoPeWorld，一个轻量级的框架，可以探测和防止渗透。具体来说，我们训练一个小的预测头 在一个冷冻的DiT隐藏状态之上 来读出一个候选人的行动是否安全。不安全的行动随后被安全的行动所取代，而安全的行动最能保持原来的意图。尽管简洁，NoPeWorld却大幅降低了物理侵权率，平均超过6个视频世界模型，从74%降至16%。值得注意的是，我们的方法显示了零射一般化 以开放域图像、第三人称视角和移动障碍。我们公开发布我们的代码， NoPeBench基准，和模型重量。项目网页：https://nopeworld.github.io。

items.detail: Symbolic models make melody, harmony, rhythm, and form explicit but typically stop before a finished recording; audio models produce complete songs while leaving composition implicit. We introduce YuE2, which unifies symbolic and audio music generation at frontier quality through symbolic planning. A single AR-NAR Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) first writes a readable score specifying melody and harmony, expands it into semantic music tokens, and realizes it as full-song audio. In comparisons using the same checkpoint, experts prefer symbolic planning for overall quality and musicality, with 49.3% of overall preferences versus 34.6% without planning. Experts also favor the unified model over a separate language model and diffusion Transformer. On WildSongBench, YuE2 scores 6.73 on SongBench Global Avg, exceeding all evaluated public baselines. Selecting from eight candidates (best-of-8), YuE2 reaches 6.96, the highest observed mean among all evaluated systems. Expert listening further establishes its competitiveness with proprietary song generators, favoring best-of-8 over Suno v4.5 and yielding nearly balanced preferences against Suno v5. To learn this generation process from recordings without aligned scores, we introduce MERT2 and SheetSage2 to supply semantic and symbolic supervision. MERT2 sets a new state of the art in music representation learning, surpassing previous best results on 14 of 15 MARBLE metrics; SheetSage2 leads 12 of 15 benchmark-metric pairs in our lead-sheet transcription comparison. The same checkpoint follows score edits while largely preserving unedited musical content and generates zero-shot covers without cover-specific training. Its readable score also enables agentic music editing, with external language models translating user feedback into revisions of the composition.
items.title_zh: YUE2：统一符号和音频音乐生成，以前沿质量
items.detail_zh: 符号模型使旋律，和谐，节奏，并形成清晰但一般在完成录制之前停止；音频模型产生完整的歌曲，同时隐含成分。我们介绍YUE2，它通过象征性的规划，统一了象征和音频音乐的制作，具有前沿质量。单曲AR-NAR Mixture-of-Transformers(MOT)首先写了一个可读的分数，指定了旋律与和谐，将其扩展为语义音乐符号，并实现为全声乐。在使用同一检查站进行比较时，专家倾向于对整体质量和音乐性进行象征性规划，49.3%的总体偏好，34.6%没有规划。专家们也赞成统一模式，而不是单独的语言模式和传播变形器。在WildSong Bench上，YuE2在Song Bench Global Avg上得分6.73，超过了所有评价的公共基线。从8名候选人(最佳8名)中挑选，YUE2达到6.96，是所有被评价系统中观察到的最高平均值。专家的倾听进一步确立了其与专有歌曲生成器的竞争力，倾向于优胜8胜于Suno v4.5，并产生对Suno v5的近乎平衡的偏好。为了从没有对齐分数的录音中学习这个生成过程，我们引入了MERT2和SeetSage2来提供语义和符号监督。 MERT2设定了音乐表现学习的新艺术水平，超越了15个MARBLE 度量衡中的14个的以往最佳成绩； SheetSage2 领先了15个基准度量配对中的12个，在我们的铅板抄录比较中。同一检查点遵循分数编辑，同时基本上保留未经编辑的音乐内容，并产生零镜头封面，而不进行特定封面训练。它的可读分数也使得代理音乐编辑成为可能，外部语言模型将用户反馈翻译为对构成的修订。

items.detail: System One models such as Jev return decisions through fast, parallel prediction. In this paper, we introduce Jeveration, showing that the same decision paradigm can also generate high-quality images in a single forward pass. Jeveration builds on a frozen vision-language model, repurposing its visual-semantic knowledge for holistic image generation. The key challenge is to maintain global consistency. A single prompt admits many valid images, yet parallel predictions must converge on a coherent whole. We therefore condition all positions on a shared random state to coordinate parallel predictions, so that each draw yields a different but coherent image. Since the model tends to ignore this state under direct image supervision, we first learn a distribution over discrete image codes to guide single-pass generation. Beyond text-to-image generation, we further unify image-to-image generation and dense prediction within the same architecture, so that one checkpoint supports all three tasks, each in one forward pass. Experiments show that Jeveration generates a 512x512 image in 78 ms, up to 122x faster than existing unified models, while maintaining competitive image quality and dense prediction performance.
items.title_zh: 热化：系统一个模型现在生成
items.detail_zh: 系统 一个模型，如Jev通过快速，平行的预测返回决定。在本文中，我们介绍了Jeveration，表明同样的决定范式也可以在一次前传中产生高质量的图像。 Jeveration以冷冻的视觉语言模式为基础，将其视觉语义知识重新用于整体图像生成。主要挑战是保持全球一致性。单一的提示承认了许多有效的图像，但并行的预测必须一致地形成一个连贯的整体。因此，我们把所有立场都建立在共同的随机状态上，以协调平行的预测，这样每一幅图都会产生不同但一致的形象。由于模型倾向于在直接的图像监督下忽略这种状态，我们首先在离散的图像代码上学习分布，以引导单传生成。除了文本到图像生成之外，我们进一步将图像到图像生成和密集的预测统一在同一架构内，这样一个检查点就能支持所有三项任务，每个任务都以一个前传的方式进行。实验显示，Jeveration在78ms中生成512x512图像，最高速度比现有的统一模型快122x，同时保持有竞争力的图像质量和密集的预测性能。

items.detail: AI-driven game development holds the potential to transform diverse human inspirations into interactive experiences. However, existing systems and benchmarks primarily focus on explicit development specifications, with limited support for adapting multimodal references and evaluating actual gameplay experiences. We introduce GameAnything, an open-source agentic platform that transforms multimodal inspirations into playable extensions of existing games through iterative development. GameAnything integrates coding agents with an independent playtesting critic, persistent development state, and reusable experience memory to support continuous refinement. We further present GameAnything-Bench, a benchmark spanning diverse reference modalities, game creation objectives, and gaming environments, with exploratory gameplay testing to assess both functional correctness and gameplay quality. Evaluations of nine coding agent configurations reveal that current agents can adapt reference content but still struggle with playable interactions and precise modifications. Moreover, multimodal references improve content fidelity, while iterative refinement yields substantial but varying improvements across agents. These findings highlight both the potential and remaining challenges of inspiration-driven game development.
items.title_zh: Game anything：从任何灵感到可玩游戏世界
items.detail_zh: AI驱动的游戏开发具有将不同的人类灵感转化为互动体验的潜力。然而，现有的系统和基准主要侧重于明确的开发规格，对调整多式联运参考和评价实际游戏经验的支持有限。我们引入了GameAnything，一个开源代理平台，通过迭代开发将多模式灵感转化为现有游戏的可玩扩展。 GameAnything将编码代理与独立的游戏测试评论员，持续开发状态，以及可再用的经验内存相融合，支持不断完善。我们进一步介绍了GameAnything-Bench，这是一个涵盖多种参考模式，游戏创作目标，游戏环境的基准，并进行了探索性的游戏游戏测试，以评估功能正确性和游戏游戏质量。对9个编码代理配置的评价显示，目前的代理可以调整参考内容，但仍与可玩性互动和精确修改相抗衡。此外，多式提法提高了内容的忠诚度，而迭接性改进则产生不同代理人之间实质性但有差异的改进。这些发现凸显出由灵感驱动的游戏开发的潜在和还存在的挑战。

items.detail: Assistants from 2011 answered and waited, and agents from 2023 did a task and stopped. In September 2026 Meta's Muse showed an agent for one person, with accounts, devices, memory and a conversation that lasts, closed, in a vendor's cloud, in one country. Such an agent is expected to act on a person's accounts and devices, remember them across weeks, speak first when it is worth it, and answer for what it did. It is a kind of software, not a model, and until now had no open counterpart. This report defines the personal agent in five questions and three horizons. It reads how Muse is built from Meta's public record and a copy of its production prompt, each statement marked by its source. It then presents nanoMuse, the open-source counterpart under the GPL-3.0, one agent on every device a person owns, with hands on the phone's screen and the computer's. They share one conversation over a relay anyone can run; every action goes through a Sentinel, memory is files the person can read, and the model is their choice. Its size and cost are given as estimates. What is open, memory with provenance, an evaluation suite for the hands and an open model for them, is set out as a roadmap.

items.detail: Lloyd's k-means algorithm is a long-running standard for clustering, with applications in data analysis, retrieval, quantization and data curation. In this paper, we introduce an exponential moving average optimization procedure for k-means with mini-batch updates, powered by modern deep learning machinery and new insights. We also establish scaling laws on how decay rate and batch size impact final performance. This gives us a formulaic rule to fix them for multiple problem sizes and embedding datasets, without the need for any hyperparameter sweep. The resulting clustering algorithm, coined e-means, is much faster than Lloyd k-means and converges to lower losses, frequently even beating k-means++. On a wide array of embeddings datasets, it beats the loss of Lloyd k-means at 25 epochs in 1.4 to 2.6 epochs, which translates to 10-45x GPU wall-clock speedups compared to state-of-the-art k-means implementations. As an example, e-means partitions DINO10B, a dataset of 10 billion DINO embeddings, into 16 million clusters in only 2.5 epochs, reaching a loss below Lloyd's at 25 epochs.

items.detail: Autoregressive video diffusion models generate frames based on new observations and inputs, making them a promising medium for interactive visual experiences. However, existing models are orders of magnitude too slow for fluid interaction. This paper introduces FastFrames, a family of fast autoregressive video diffusion models that achieves interactive latency without compromising quality. We profile the inference pipeline of state-of-the-art models and find that operations often treated as fixed implementation details, such as VAE decoding and KV cache updates, in fact account for over half of end-to-end inference latency. We challenge the assumption that these components are indispensable and replace them with lightweight alternatives. Our 1.3B variant runs at 36 ms per frame, or 28 responses per second (RPS), on a single B200 GPU while matching the generation quality of a state-of-the-art model that is nearly 8x slower. Our 14B variant runs at 45 ms per frame, or 22 RPS, on an 8x B200 GPU node and yields significantly better visual quality and realism. We show that FastFrames enables real-time interaction in applications such as camera-conditioned and physics-conditioned video generation.
items.title_zh: FastFrames：互动空档的视频生成
items.detail_zh: 自动回归式视频传播模型基于新的观察和投入生成帧，使其成为互动视觉体验的有希望的媒介。然而，对于流体相互作用而言，现有的模型数量级太慢。本文引入了FastFrames，这是一组快速自旋式视频传播模式，在不损及质量的情况下实现互动性延时。我们剖析了最先进的模型的推论管道，发现操作经常作为固定执行细节处理，如VAE解码和KV缓存更新，实际上占到端到端推论延迟的一半以上。我们对这些组成部分不可或缺并用轻量级替代品取代的假设提出质疑。我们的1.3B变体运行在单个B200GPU上，每帧36ms，或每秒28个响应(RPS)，同时匹配近8x慢的先进型号的生成质量。我们的14B变体在8x B200 GPU节点上运行，每帧45ms，或22 RTS，并产生显著的更好的视觉质量和现实性。我们显示 FastFrames 可以实时交互应用，例如相机和物理设备的视频生成。

items.title: Qwen3-TTS Technical Report
items.subtitle: In this report, we present the Qwen3-TTS series, a family of advanced multilingual, controllable, robust, and streaming text-to-speech models. Trained on over 5 million hours of speech data spanning 10 languages, Qwen3-TTS adopts a dual-track LM architecture for real-time synthesis, coupled with two speech tokenizers: 1) Qwen-TTS-Tokenizer-25Hz is a single-codebook codec emphasizing semantic content, which offers seamlessly integration with Qwen-Audio and enables streaming waveform reconstruction vi
items.detail: In this report, we present the Qwen3-TTS series, a family of advanced multilingual, controllable, robust, and streaming text-to-speech models. Qwen3-TTS supports state-of-the-art 3-second voice cloning and description-based control, allowing both the creation of entirely novel voices and fine-grained manipulation over the output speech. Trained on over 5 million hours of speech data spanning 10 languages, Qwen3-TTS adopts a dual-track LM architecture for real-time synthesis, coupled with two speech tokenizers: 1) Qwen-TTS-Tokenizer-25Hz is a single-codebook codec emphasizing semantic content, which offers seamlessly integration with Qwen-Audio and enables streaming waveform reconstruction via a block-wise DiT. 2) Qwen-TTS-Tokenizer-12Hz achieves extreme bitrate reduction and ultra-low-latency streaming, enabling immediate first-packet emission (97,ms) through its 12.5 Hz, 16-layer multi-codebook design and a lightweight causal ConvNet. Extensive experiments indicate state-of-the-art performance across diverse objective and subjective benchmark (e.g., TTS multilingual test set, InstructTTSEval, and our long speech test set). To facilitate community research and development, we release both tokenizers and models under the Apache 2.0 license.
items.title_zh: Qune3-TTS 技术报告
items.detail_zh: 在本报告中，我们介绍了Qune3-TTS系列，这是一个由先进的多语种，可控，强健，流畅的文本对语音模型组成的家族。 Qune3-TTS支持最先进的3秒语音克隆和基于描述的控制，既允许创造全新的声音，也允许精细地操纵输出语音。 Qune3-TTS对跨越10种语言的500多万小时的语音数据进行了培训，采用双轨LM架构进行实时合成，并配有两种语音示意器： 1) Qun-TTS-Tokenizer-25Hz是一个强调语义内容的单码簿编码器，它提供与Qun-Audio的无缝集成，并通过区块化的DiT.2实现流波形重建 2) Qun-TTS-Tokenizer-12Hz实现极端比特率的降低和超低纬度流化，通过它的12.5Hz，16层多码簿设计以及轻量因子ConvNet，使得立即的第一包排放(97，ms)成为可能。广泛的实验表明跨越不同客观和主观基准(如TTS多语种测试集，InstructTTSEval，以及我们的长语音测试集)的先进性能。为了促进社区研发，我们根据Apache 2.0许可证发布了标致剂和模型。

items.detail: AI agents working on long tasks often commit to an answer before they have enough evidence, a behavior called laziness. In our evaluations, they frequently commit even while their stated belief still names several possible answers. An outcome reward at the end of the episode scores only the final answer, so it cannot teach the agent when to commit, because a lucky guess receives the same reward as an answer backed by evidence. During training, however, the simulator can compute the exact posterior over the answer at every step and tell whether the evidence is already enough. We propose Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Beliefs (RLVB), which rewards the agent for taking further steps while this posterior still allows several answers and for committing once the evidence is sufficient. The reward needs no judge, critic or reward model, and it never reads the belief line the agent writes before each action. We also introduce Pro Worlds, a benchmark of visual puzzles where the agent views a large world through a small window. We evaluate three vision-language models on three benchmarks, two of which are never seen in training. RLVB improves the base model in all nine settings, by 17.1% on average. Under the outcome reward, GRPO and PPO fall below the base model on average. RLVB also outperforms PPO with a process reward from an LLM judge by 9.3% on average while using 1.6 times fewer GPU-hours. The trained agent answers with sufficient evidence in 51%, 12% and 74% of the episodes on the three benchmarks, against 8%, 0.4% and 36% for the base model. Its accuracy gain therefore comes from answering more often at high levels of evidence. The belief line shows how the agent reaches this evidence: it acts on its own belief. It commits at only 0.1 to 2.2% of the turns at which the evidence is insufficient and its line still names several answers, against 3 to 68% for the base model.
items.title_zh: 懒惰的代理人回答反对他们自己的信仰：用可验证的信仰加强学习 教导他们如何行动
items.detail_zh: 从事长任务工作的AI特工常常在他们掌握足够证据之前就致力于一个答案，这个行为被称为懒惰。在我们的评价中，他们经常做出承诺，尽管他们所宣称的信念仍然是几个可能的答案。剧集结尾的结局奖励只得最后的答案，因此无法教特工何时犯罪，因为幸运猜想得到的奖励与证据支持的答案相同。然而，在训练期间，模拟器可以在每一个步骤上对答案进行精确的后后计算，并判断证据是否已经足够。我们建议加强使用可验证信仰的学习(RLVB)，该方法奖励代理人采取进一步措施，而这一事后仍允许作出若干答复，一旦证据充分，就予以执行。奖赏不需要法官、评论家或奖赏模式，我们还引入了Pro Worlds(Pro Worlds)，这是一个视觉谜题的基准，其中代理商通过一个小窗口看待一个大的世界。我们在三个基准上评价三个视觉语言模式，其中两个在培训中从未见过。 RLVB在所有9个设置中都改进了基础模型，平均提高了17.1%。在结果奖励下，GRPO和PPO平均低于基准模式。 RLVB还比PPO表现优于LLM法官的流程奖励，平均为9.3%，同时使用比GPU小时少1.6倍。受过培训的代理人在三个基准的51%、12%和74%的事故中提供了充分的证据，而基数模型为8%、0.4%和36%。因此，它的准确性增益来自更经常地在高证据水平下回答。信仰线显示代理人是如何到达这个证据的：它凭自己的信仰行事。它只承担了证据不足的0.1%至2.2%的转弯，而且其线路仍然列出了几个答案，而基准模型为3%至68%。

items.detail: Full-duplex interaction models exhibit strong conversational agency, enabling natural, low-latency turn-taking, backchannels, and interruptions. However, completing tasks further requires task agency: timely tool invocation and argument revision following user corrections. Frontend-backend agents separate initiation from execution: the frontend decides whether and what to request, while the backend determines how. Execution can be offloaded, but unsent requests cannot be executed, and incomplete ones can misdirect the backend. On Full-Duplex-Bench v3 (FDB v3), most failures of Realtime-Venus-Audio + Harness in our streaming pipeline occur before a domain tool executes. We introduce Duopra, a full-duplex interaction model that learns task execution alongside conversational control. Duopra treats the backend as a tool, accepting a self-contained natural-language request. Direct calls and backend delegation share an action interface and requirements for faithful initiation and correct execution. Its three-stage training combines protocol SFT, full-duplex RL rewarding timely and complete execution, and projector-only repair of talker conditioning after thinker updates. With the same backend, Pass@1 rises from 4.7% to 44.7%; Duopra achieves 47.7% calling tools directly (26.0% after SFT) and 49.3% with a DeepSeek backend. It improves three FDB v1.0 takeover rates over the base model. These results show that task agency can coexist with key conversational agency.
items.title_zh: Duopra：从全双面对话到全双面机构
items.detail_zh: 完全复式互动模型显示出强大的对话机构，能够自然地、低纬度地进行转换、反通道和中断。然而，完成任务还需要任务机构：在用户更正后及时引用工具和修改论据。前端后端代理将启动与执行分开：前端决定是否以及要求什么，而后端决定如何。执行可以被卸载，但未经同意的请求不能执行，不完整的请求可以错误地引导后端。在Full-Duplex-Bench v3(FDB v3)上，我们流线管中Realtime-Venus-Audio + Harness的大部分故障发生在域工具执行之前。我们引入了Duopra，一个全复式交互模型，学习任务执行与对话控制。 Duopra将后端视为工具，接受自成一体的自然语言请求。直接通话和后端授权共享一个行动界面，以及忠实启动和正确执行的要求。它的三阶段训练结合了协议SFT，全复式RL奖励及时和完整的执行，以及思想者更新后仅投影者修复谈话器的调制。使用相同的后端，Pass@1从4.7%升至44.7%；Duopra直接实现47.7%的调用工具(SFT后为26.0%)，49.3%的调用为DeepSeek后端。它提高了三个FDB v1.0收购率，超过了基准模型。这些结果显示任务机构可以与关键的对话机构共存。

items.title: PDFMathTranslate: Scientific Document Translation Preserving Layouts
items.subtitle: Language barriers in scientific documents hinder the diffusion and development of science and technologies. However, prior efforts in translating such documents largely overlooked the information in layouts. To bridge the gap, we introduce PDFMathTranslate, the world's first open-source software for translating scientific documents while preserving layouts. Leveraging the most recent advances in large language models and precise layout detection, we contribute to the community with key improvements in precision, flexibility, and efficiency. The work has been open-sourced at https://github.com/byaidu/pdfmathtranslate with more than 222k downloads.

items.detail: Well-designed prompts are crucial for enhancing Large language models' (LLMs) reasoning capabilities while aligning their outputs with task requirements across diverse domains. However, manually designed prompts require expertise and iterative experimentation. While existing prompt optimization methods aim to automate this process, they rely heavily on external references such as ground truth or by humans, limiting their applicability in real-world scenarios where such data is unavailable or costly to obtain. To address this, we propose Self-Supervised Prompt Optimization (SPO), a cost-efficient framework that discovers effective prompts for both closed and open-ended tasks without requiring external reference. Motivated by the observations that prompt quality manifests directly in LLM outputs and LLMs can effectively assess adherence to task requirements, we derive evaluation and optimization signals purely from output comparisons. Specifically, SPO selects superior prompts through pairwise output comparisons evaluated by an LLM evaluator, followed by an LLM optimizer that aligns outputs with task requirements. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SPO outperforms state-of-the-art prompt optimization methods, achieving comparable or superior results with significantly lower costs (e.g., 1.1% to 5.6% of existing methods) and fewer samples (e.g., three samples). The code is available at https://github.com/geekan/MetaGPT.
items.title_zh: 自控快速优化
items.detail_zh: 精心设计的提示对于加强大型语言模型的推理能力至关重要，同时使其产出符合不同领域的任务要求。然而，人工设计的提示需要专门知识和反复试验。虽然现有的即时优化方法旨在使这一过程自动化，但它们严重依赖外部参考，如地面真相或人类的参考，限制了这些参考方法在缺乏数据或获取数据费用高昂的现实世界情景中的适用性。为了解决这一问题，我们提议自我监督的快速优化(SPO)，这是一个成本效益高的框架，在不需要外部参考的情况下，为封闭和开放的任务找出有效的诱因。我们的动机是，迅速的质量直接体现在LLM产出中，而LLM能够有效评估对任务要求的遵守情况，因此，我们纯粹从产出比较中获得评价和优化信号。具体来说，SPO通过由LLM评价员评价的对偶输出比较来选择上等提示，然后选择LLM优化器，使输出与任务要求保持一致。广泛的实验表明，SPO优于最先进的即时优化方法，取得可比或优异的结果，成本显著降低(如现有方法的1.1%至5.6%)，样本较少(如三个样本)。该代码可在https://github.com/geekan/MetaGPT上查阅。

items.detail: Building applications that perceive the world around them is challenging. A developer needs to (a) select and develop corresponding machine learning algorithms and models, (b) build a series of prototypes and demos, (c) balance resource consumption against the quality of the solutions, and finally (d) identify and mitigate problematic cases. The MediaPipe framework addresses all of these challenges. A developer can use MediaPipe to build prototypes by combining existing perception components, to advance them to polished cross-platform applications and measure system performance and resource consumption on target platforms. We show that these features enable a developer to focus on the algorithm or model development and use MediaPipe as an environment for iteratively improving their application with results reproducible across different devices and platforms. MediaPipe will be open-sourced at https://github.com/google/mediapipe.
items.title_zh: MediaPipe：建设认知管道的框架
items.detail_zh: 建立能感知周围世界的应用是具有挑战性的。开发者需要(a) 选择和开发相应的机器学习算法和模型，(b) 建立一系列原型和演示，(c) 平衡资源消耗与解决方案质量，最后(d) 发现并缓解有问题的案例。 MediaPipe框架处理所有这些挑战。一个开发者可以使用MediaPipe通过将现有的感知组件组合起来来构建原型，以推进它们来抛光跨平台的应用程序并测量目标平台的系统性能和资源消耗。我们显示，这些特性使开发者能够专注于算法或模型开发，并使用MediaPipe作为环境来反复改进它们的应用，其结果可以在不同设备和平台上复制。 MediaPipe将在https://github.com/google/mediapipe上开源。

items.subtitle: Games, especially modern AAA games, challenge language models to perceive complex scenes, control actions, and make decisions over long horizons. items.detail: Games, especially modern AAA games, challenge language models to perceive complex scenes, control actions, and make decisions over long horizons. Existing game benchmarks primarily test language models as computer-use agents that query a language model throughout play, incurring repeated inference cost and, in real-time games, acting while the environment continues to evolve. We ask whether coding agents can learn from game interaction to develop standalone game-playing programs that run without language model inference. We thus introduce Coding4Games, a benchmark for evaluating whether coding agents can develop standalone programs that play modern games through visual observations and standard game inputs. Coding4Games has three defining features: 1) Diverse Modern Games, covering 15 games with diverse visual, strategic, and control demands; 2) Development-Test Separation, in which a coding agent uses a sandbox and the standard player interface to iteratively develop a program, after which the selected program is frozen and independently tested without language-model inference; and 3) Outcome and Process Evaluation, which measures not only game performance and reliability but also how agents use feedback, revise programs, and resolve problems during development. Across 15 games, the best program per game outscores the strongest GUI baseline on 13 and ties it on one. The human player outscores all agents on 10 games. We additionally examine the effects of development budgets. Coding4Games evaluates whether coding agents can turn their understanding of complex interactive environments into programs that work reliably on their own.
items.title_zh: 编码4Games：现代编码代理可以玩现代电子游戏吗？。
items.detail_zh: 游戏，特别是现代的AAA游戏，挑战语言模型来感知复杂的场景，控制动作，并在长视野上做出决策。现有的游戏基准主要测试语言模型，作为计算机使用代理人，在整个游戏过程中查询语言模型，产生反复的推论成本，在实时游戏中，在环境继续演化的同时采取行动。我们询问编码代理是否能够从游戏互动中学习开发独立运行的游戏游戏游戏程序，而无需语言模型推论。因此，我们引入了Coding4Games，这是评价编码代理商是否能够通过视觉观察和标准游戏输入来开发独立程序来玩现代游戏的基准。 Cording4Games有三种定义特征：1)多元现代游戏，涵盖15个游戏，具有多种视觉，战略，控制需求； 2) Development-Test Specification，其中编码代理使用沙盒和标准玩家界面来迭代地开发出一个程序，之后选定的程序被冻结并独立地测试而不使用语言模型推论；3)结果与过程评价，它不仅衡量游戏的性能和可靠性，而且衡量代理如何使用反馈，修改程序，并在开发过程中解决问题。在15场比赛中，每场比赛最好的程序胜过13场的GUI最强基线，并将它连在一起。人类玩家在10场比赛中胜出所有特工。我们还审查了发展预算的影响。编码4 Games评价编码代理商是否能够将他们对复杂互动环境的理解转化为能够可靠地独立运行的程序。

We add some novel improvements. items.detail: Recently, large language model (LLM) based text-to-speech (TTS) systems have gradually become the mainstream in the industry due to their high naturalness and powerful zero-shot voice cloning capabilities.Here, we introduce the IndexTTS system, which is mainly based on the XTTS and Tortoise model. We add some novel improvements. Specifically, in Chinese scenarios, we adopt a hybrid modeling method that combines characters and pinyin, making the pronunciations of polyphonic characters and long-tail characters controllable. We also performed a comparative analysis of the Vector Quantization (VQ) with Finite-Scalar Quantization (FSQ) for codebook utilization of acoustic speech tokens. To further enhance the effect and stability of voice cloning, we introduce a conformer-based speech conditional encoder and replace the speechcode decoder with BigVGAN2. Compared with XTTS, it has achieved significant improvements in naturalness, content consistency, and zero-shot voice cloning. As for the popular TTS systems in the open-source, such as Fish-Speech, CosyVoice2, FireRedTTS and F5-TTS, IndexTTS has a relatively simple training process, more controllable usage, and faster inference speed. Moreover, its performance surpasses that of these systems. Our demos are available at https://index-tts.github.io.
items.title_zh: IndexTTS：工业一级可控和高效的零热文本对语音系统
items.detail_zh: 最近，基于文字对语音(TTS)的大型语言模型(LLM)系统由于具有较高的自然性和强大的零镜头语音克隆能力，逐渐成为业界的主流。在这里，我们引入了IndexTTS系统，该系统主要基于XTTS和龟模型。我们补充了一些新的改进。具体来说，在汉语情景中，我们采用混合模型方法，将字符和pinyin结合，使多音字符和长尾字符的发音可以控制。我们还与Finite-Scalar Quantization(FSQ)对矢量量量化(VQ)进行了比较分析，用于编码本使用声学语音符号。为了进一步提高语音克隆的效果和稳定性，我们引入了以听素为基础的语音条件编码器，并将语音码解码器替换为BigVGAN2。与XTTS相比，在自然性，内容一致性，以及零镜头语音克隆方面都取得了显著的改善。至于开源软件中流行的TTS系统，如Fish-Speech，CosyVoice2，FireRedTTS和F5-TTS，IndexTTS的训练过程相对简单，使用率比较可控，推论速度更快。此外，其业绩超过了这些系统。我们的演示可在https://index-ts.github.io上查阅。

items.detail: People reason with pictures as well as words. Interleaved multimodal reasoning gives models a similar way to solve problems by creating intermediate images and using them to guide further reasoning. Training models with this ability usually relies on task-specific demonstrations, which are difficult to collect. We introduce ThinkMorph-SSL, a two-stage training recipe that uses images themselves as a source of supervision. The first stage, pretext reasoning, converts visual pretext tasks, such as image colorization and denoising, into instruction-free interleaved traces. Models describe a corrupted or transformed image, generate a restored or canonical image, and interpret the result. The second stage uses automatically constructed demonstrations for question-driven instruction tuning. At the same instruction-tuning budget, models trained with pretext reasoning outperform those trained with instruction tuning alone. The full recipe improves over the base model by an average of 11.33 accuracy points across twelve benchmarks. These results show that supervision derived from images can build the visual skills needed for interleaved reasoning and improve learning from task-specific demonstrations.
items.title_zh: ThinkMorph-SSL：以预文本任务放大互放的多式程序
items.detail_zh: 人们用图片和文字来解释。互放多式推理通过创建中间图像并利用它们来指导进一步推理，给模型提供了类似的解决问题的方法。具有这种能力的培训模式通常依赖于任务特定的演示，这些演示很难收集。我们介绍ThinkMorph-SSL，一种两阶段的训练食谱，将图像本身作为监督的来源。第一阶段，借口推理，将视觉借口任务，如图像取色和去诺等，转换为无指令的互放痕迹。模型描述一个被腐蚀或被改造的图像，生成一个被恢复的或被改变的图像，并解释结果。第二阶段使用自动构造的演示来进行由问题驱动的指令调试。在同一指导调整预算中，以借口推理培训的模型比仅通过指导调整培训的模型要好。整个食谱比基准模型提高了12个基准的平均11.33个准确点。这些结果表明，从图像中产生的监督可以建立交互推理所需的视觉技能并改进对特定任务演示的学习。

items.title: RUIBench: What Makes a Good Robot-Use Interface?

items.detail: Foundation models can reason about complex physical tasks, yet translating this intelligence into reliable robot execution remains challenging. We argue that a critical, often overlooked factor is the robot-use interface (RUI), which determines how agents express and execute physical actions. To systematically study its impact, we introduce RUIBench, comprising 30 manipulation tasks across five suites spanning world knowledge, in-context learning, discovery, dynamic interaction, and contact-rich manipulation. We further develop RUIKit, a unified framework that crosses six action abstractions with two interaction forms, yielding 13 interfaces under shared perception and control. In simulation, changing only the RUI shifts a frontier agent's success rate from 45% to 81%, and that of a fine-tuned 4B model from 13% to 47%. Our analysis reveals that effective interfaces reduce unnecessary decisions while preserving essential feedback, with their benefits shaped by agent behavior and physical uncertainty. We further uncover a verification gap, where agents frequently declare success despite observable failures, revealing the need for task-level verification beyond individual actions. Together, these findings establish RUI design as a critical factor in embodied agent reliability.
items.detail_zh: 基础模型可以解释复杂的物理任务，然而将这种智能转化为可靠的机器人执行仍然具有挑战性。我们主张，一个关键且经常被忽略的因素就是机器人-使用界面(RUI)，它决定着特工如何表达和执行物理动作。为了系统地研究其影响，我们引入了RUIBENCH，包括30个操控任务，跨越五套涵盖世界知识、内涵学习、发现、动态互动和丰富接触的操控。我们进一步发展了RUIKit，这个统一框架跨越了六个有两种互动形式的动作抽象，在共同感知和控制下产生了13个界面。在模拟中，仅改变RUI将前沿代理的成功率从45%转移到了81%，而微调后4B模型的成功率从13%调到了47%。我们的分析表明，有效的接口既能减少不必要的决定，又能保存必要的反馈，其好处由代理行为和身体不确定性所决定。我们进一步发现了一个核查差距，即代理人经常宣布成功，尽管有明显的失败，这表明除了个别行动之外，还需要进行任务一级的核查。这些结论共同确定RUI设计是体现的物剂可靠性的一个关键因素。

items.detail: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is increasingly deployed in enterprise search and document-centric assistants, where responses must be grounded in long and complex source materials. In practice, verifying that generated answers faithfully reflect retrieved documents is difficult: large language models can check long contexts but are too slow and costly for interactive services, while lightweight classifiers operate within strict context limits and frequently miss evidence outside truncated passages. We present the design of a real-time verification component integrated into a production RAG pipeline that enables full-document grounding under latency constraints. The system processes documents up to 32K tokens and employs adaptive inference strategies to balance response time and verification coverage across workloads. We describe the architectural decisions, operational trade-offs, and evaluation methodology used to deploy the verifier, and show that full-context verification substantially improves detection of unsupported responses compared with truncated validation. Our experience highlights when long-context verification is necessary, why chunk-based checking often fails in real documents, and how latency budgets shape model design. These findings provide practical guidance for practitioners building reliable large-scale retrieval-augmented applications. (Model, benchmark, and code: https://huggingface.co/llm-semantic-router)
items.title_zh: 快速而忠实：长文件检索强化生成系统的实时验证
items.detail_zh: 在企业搜索和以文件为中心的助理中，越来越多地部署检索增强的生成(RAG)，这些助理的反应必须基于长期和复杂的原始材料。在实践中，核查生成的答案忠实地反映检索到的文档是困难的：大型语言模型可以检查较长的上下文，但对于交互服务来说太慢和成本太高，而轻量级分类器在严格的上下文限制下运行，经常在截断的段落之外错过证据。我们提出将实时核查部分纳入生产RAG管道的设计，以便在暂时性限制下全面铺设文件。该系统处理多达32K令牌的文件，并采用适应性的推断战略，以平衡反应时间和工作量的核查范围。我们描述了用于部署核查员的建筑决定、业务权衡和评价方法，并表明，与短时间验证相比，全文核查大大改进了对无支持答复的检测。我们的经验突出表明，何时需要长文核查，为什么在真实文件中往往不进行块式检查，以及预算如何塑造模型。这些研究结果为从业人员建设可靠的大规模检索强化应用程序提供了实际指导。 (模式、基准和代码：https://huggingface.co/llm-semantic-router)

items.detail: Agentic coding tools receive goals written in natural language as input, break them down into specific tasks, and write or execute the actual code with minimal human intervention. Central to this process are agent context files ("READMEs for agents") that provide persistent, project-level instructions. In this paper, we conduct the first large-scale empirical study of 2,303 agent context files from 1,925 repositories to characterize their structure, maintenance, and content. We find that these files are not static documentation but complex, difficult-to-read artifacts that evolve like configuration code, maintained through frequent, small additions. Our content analysis of 16 instruction types shows that developers prioritize functional context, such as build and run commands (62.3%), implementation details (69.9%), and architecture (67.7%). We also identify a significant gap: non-functional requirements like security (14.5%) and performance (14.5%) are rarely specified. These findings indicate that while developers use context files to make agents functional, they provide few guardrails to ensure that agent-written code is secure or performant, highlighting the need for improved tooling and practices.
items.title_zh: 代理 READMEs：代理编码背景文件的实证研究
items.detail_zh: 代理编码工具接收以自然语言写成的目标作为输入，将其细分为具体任务，并在最小的人类干预下编写或执行实际代码。这个过程的核心是代理上下文文件("用于代理的READMEs")，提供持久，项目级指令。在本文中，我们对来自1,925个寄存器的2,303个代理上下文文件进行了第一次大规模的实证研究，以描述其结构、维护和内容。我们发现，这些文件不是静态文件，而是复杂，难以阅读的文物，它们像配置代码一样演化，通过频繁的小添加来维护。我们对16种指令类型的内容分析显示，开发者优先排序功能环境，如构建和运行命令(62.3%)，实施细节(69.9%)，以及架构(67.7%)。我们还发现存在一个重大差距：安保(14.5%)和业绩(14.5%)等不起作用的要求很少得到说明。这些发现表明，开发者虽然使用上下文文件来使代理机功能化，但是他们提供很少的护栏来保证代理机写代码的安全性或性能，突出了改进工具和做法的必要性。

items.detail: GUI grounding requires precise clicks at low latency. Recent models such as GUI-Decisions and GUI-Swift predict coordinates in one forward pass using fixed global bins with local refinement. However, screenshot downsampling removes detail needed to locate small controls, while fixed bins cover larger pixel ranges at higher resolutions. We introduce PixelOne, which transfers spatial knowledge from a search teacher to a student that predicts clicks directly from screenshots at native resolution. The teacher uses VideoJEV's text-option scorer to select rows and columns and progressively zoom into candidate regions. The student inherits the teacher's parameters and matches its distributions over explored regions through spatial distillation alongside box supervision. At inference, the same decision head selects a visual token, and a lightweight pixel head predicts the click within it, all in one forward pass. A click-aligned loss encourages pixels inside the target box to score above those outside. Across four benchmarks, PixelOne-Pro-35B-A3B achieves 83.8% mean accuracy, the highest among the evaluated single-forward grounders, with a mean latency of 0.43 s per target.
items.title_zh: 像素一：从选项到像素，单向前进，用于图形界面定位
items.detail_zh: 图形用户界面定位需要精确地点击低延迟。最近的模型，例如GUI-Decisions和GUI-Swift，用固定的全局用局部精细来预测一个前行坐标。然而，截图下取样本会去除定位小控制所需要细节，而固定的bin则会以更高的分辨率覆盖更大的像素范围。我们引入了Pixel One，它将空间知识从搜索老师转移到一个学生，根据本地分辨率直接从截图上点击。老师使用VideoJEV的文本选项分数器来选择行和列并逐渐放大到候选区域。学生继承教师的参数，并通过空间分馏和箱监督来匹配其在被探索区域的分布。推想，同一个决定头会选择一个视觉符号，一个轻量级像素头会预测它内部的点击，都在一个前传。点击相通的损失鼓励目标框内的像素在外的比分上。在4个基准中，Pixel One-Pro-35B-A3B平均精度达到83.8%，在被评价的单向地面人中最高，每个目标的平均耐用度为0.43秒。

items.detail: Spatial intelligence, the ability to reason about 3D space from visual observations, becomes essential as multimodal large language models (MLLMs) move into the physical world. Beyond perceiving each view, it rests on two cornerstones of human cognition: fusing multiple views into one coherent 3D scene and mentally transforming that scene to new viewpoints as reasoning unfolds. Yet our spatial probes reveal that MLLMs largely lack both capabilities, even after spatial fine-tuning. We therefore present S-Mind, which internalizes multi-view geometry within the MLLM through a compact set of spatial tokens. It supervises these tokens to hold the fused 3D scene and re-emits them to re-express this scene from every viewpoint the reasoning adopts. Across four spatial benchmarks, S-Mind improves its Qwen3.5 backbones by up to 22.26 points and surpasses frontier general models such as GPT-6-Astra (+0.45), Kimi-K3.1-Pro (+1.97), and GLM-5.3-Flash (+7.80) in average accuracy. Moreover, the same probes confirm that it acquires both capabilities, reaching fusion and transformation accuracies of 65.11% and 82.17%, against at most 16.02% and 37.28% for the baselines. At inference, S-Mind also runs about 100x faster than a tool-based agent on the same backbone. Instilled through these spatial tokens during training, spatial capability becomes intrinsic to the backbone and persists even when the tokens are withheld, offering a promising path toward spatial intelligence in MLLMs.
items.title_zh: S-Mind：空间智能多维几何内化
items.detail_zh: 空间智能，即通过视觉观测来解释3D空间的能力，随着多式大型语言模型(MLLMs)进入物理世界而变得至关重要。除了观察每一种观点之外，它还建立在人类认知的两个基石上：将多种观点融合成一个连贯的三维场景，随着推理的展开，该场景在精神上转变为新的观点。然而，我们的空间探测器显示，即使进行了空间微调，MLLMs也基本上缺乏这两种能力。因此，我们提出S-Mind，它通过一套紧凑的空间符号，在MLLM中内化多视几何。它监督这些标志，以持有被熔化的3D场景，并重用它们从推理所采用的每个角度重新表达这个场景。在整个四个空间基准中，S-Mind将其Qune3.5主干线提高了22.26分并超过了前沿一般模型，如GPT-6-Astra (+。45)、Kimi-K3.1-Pro (+1.97)和GLM-5.3-Flash (+7.80)的平均准确度。此外，同一探测器证实它既具备能力，又达到聚变和变异速率65.11%和82.17%，而基线最高为16.02%和37.28%。推断出，S-Mind在同一个骨干上运行速度也比基于工具的代理快约100x。空间能力在训练期间通过这些空间标志被注入，成为主干部分的内在内容，即使在这些标志被扣留时仍然持续存在，为在MLLM中获取空间情报提供了一条很有希望的道路。

items.detail: Tactile sensing is an indispensable modality for contact-rich dexterous manipulation, a capability that hints at the ultimate frontiers of embodied intelligence. However, commercially available tactile sensors are still at a relatively early stage of development, with each type of sensor offering irreplaceable strengths alongside its own drawbacks. A key challenge is thus to free tactile understanding from sensor-specific physics, so that embodied models can effectively leverage heterogeneous tactile data. To this end, we develop LingBot-Touch, a tactile foundation model characterized by the following properties. (i) Our model yields a unified representation across different tactile sensors (i.e., piezoresistive, magnetic, and visuotactile sensors), and is easily extensible to new sensor types. (ii) The resulting tactile tokens are plug-and-play: they can be seamlessly integrated into policy models across paradigms, from diffusion policy to vision-language-action (VLA) models such as π_{0.5} and LingBot-VLA, consistently enhancing manipulation dexterity. (iii) Extensive experiments, spanning simulation and real-robot deployments across multiple hardware platforms, demonstrate that our tactile representation substantially benefits complex manipulation tasks while maintaining strong computational efficiency. We believe the findings in this work demonstrate the potential of leveraging cross-sensor data to scale tactile learning, and offer encouraging insights for the design of future hardware and embodied models.
items.title_zh: Dexterous Manipulation将军的学习异质图案代表
items.detail_zh: 陶瓷感知是接触力强的狡猾操纵不可或缺的方式，这种能力暗示着所体现智能的最终前沿。然而，商业上可用的触觉传感器仍处于相对较早的发展阶段，每一种传感器除了本身的缺点之外，还具有不可替代的优点。因此，一个关键挑战是从传感器特定物理学中释放触觉理解，这样所包含模型就可以有效地利用各种触觉数据。为此，我们开发了LingBot-Touch，一种具有以下特性的触觉基础模型。 (一) 我们的模型在不同触觉感应器(即偏振感应器、磁性感应器和粘度感应器)之间产生统一的表示，并易于推广到新的感应器类型。 (二) 由此产生的触觉符号是插图和游戏：它们可以无缝地融入跨范式的政策模型，从传播政策到视觉语言行动(VLA)模型，如XQ0.5}和LingBot-VLA，不断增强操纵的节奏。 (三)跨越模拟和在多个硬件平台进行实际机器人部署的广泛实验，表明我们的触觉表现在保持强大计算效率的同时，大大有利于复杂的操纵任务。我们认为，这项工作的调查结果表明，利用跨传感器数据扩大触觉学习的潜力，并为未来硬件和体现模式的设计提供了令人鼓舞的见解。

items.detail: Vision-language models (VLMs) pretrained on large-scale multimodal datasets encode rich visual and linguistic knowledge, making them a strong foundation for robotics. Rather than training robotic policies from scratch, recent approaches adapt VLMs into vision-language-action (VLA) models that enable natural language-driven perception and control. However, existing VLAs are typically massive--often with billions of parameters--leading to high training costs and limited real-world deployability. Moreover, they rely on academic and industrial datasets, overlooking the growing availability of community-collected data from affordable robotic platforms. In this work, we present SmolVLA, a small, efficient, and community-driven VLA that drastically reduces both training and inference costs, while retaining competitive performance. SmolVLA is designed to be trained on a single GPU and deployed on consumer-grade GPUs or even CPUs. To further improve responsiveness, we introduce an asynchronous inference stack decoupling perception and action prediction from action execution, allowing higher control rates with chunked action generation. Despite its compact size, SmolVLA achieves performance comparable to VLAs that are 10x larger. We evaluate SmolVLA on a range of both simulated as well as real-world robotic benchmarks and release all code, pretrained models, and training data.
items.title_zh: SmolVLA：经济适用和高效机器人的愿景-语言-行动模型
items.detail_zh: 视觉语言模型(VLMs)在大规模多式联运数据集上预训，编码了丰富的视觉和语言知识，使其成为机器人学的坚实基础。近期的方法不是从零开始培训机器人政策，而是将VLMs改造为视觉语言动作(VLA)模型，使自然语言驱动的感知和控制成为可能。然而，现有的志愿军通常规模很大，往往有数十亿个参数，导致培训费用高昂，实际世界部署能力有限。此外，它们依靠学术和工业数据集，忽略了社区从负担得起的机器人平台收集的越来越多的数据。在这项工作中，我们介绍了SmolVLA，这是一个小型、高效和社区驱动的VLA，它大大减少了培训和推论费用，同时保留了竞争性业绩。 SmolVLA的设计是在单一GPU上进行训练，并部署在消费级GPU甚至CPU上。为了进一步提高反应能力，我们引入了一个同步推论堆栈，将感知和行动预测与动作执行脱钩，从而能够用块状动作生成来提高控制率。尽管SmolVLA的体积比较紧凑，但能达到与10x更大的VLA相当的性能。我们用一系列模拟和现实世界的机器人基准来评估SmolVLA，并发布所有代码，预先训练的模型和培训数据。

items.detail: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems enhance large language models (LLMs) by integrating external knowledge sources, enabling more accurate and contextually relevant responses tailored to user needs. However, existing RAG systems have significant limitations, including reliance on flat data representations and inadequate contextual awareness, which can lead to fragmented answers that fail to capture complex inter-dependencies. To address these challenges, we propose LightRAG, which incorporates graph structures into text indexing and retrieval processes. This innovative framework employs a dual-level retrieval system that enhances comprehensive information retrieval from both low-level and high-level knowledge discovery. Additionally, the integration of graph structures with vector representations facilitates efficient retrieval of related entities and their relationships, significantly improving response times while maintaining contextual relevance. This capability is further enhanced by an incremental update algorithm that ensures the timely integration of new data, allowing the system to remain effective and responsive in rapidly changing data environments. Extensive experimental validation demonstrates considerable improvements in retrieval accuracy and efficiency compared to existing approaches. We have made our LightRAG open-source and available at the link: https://github.com/HKUDS/LightRAG.
items.title_zh: LightRAG：简单且快速的检索增强生成
items.detail_zh: 检索增强生成(RAG)系统通过整合外部知识来源来增强大型语言模型(LLMS)，从而能够根据用户需求做出更加准确和符合具体情况的反应。然而，现有的RAG系统有重大的局限性，包括依赖统一的数据表示和缺乏对背景的认识，这可能导致答案分散，无法反映复杂的相互依存关系。为了应对这些挑战，我们提议使用LightRAG，将图表结构纳入文本索引和检索过程。这一创新框架采用双层检索系统，加强从低层和高级知识发现中的全面信息检索。此外，将图表结构与矢量表示法结合起来，有助于高效检索相关实体及其关系，大大改善反应时间，同时保持关联性。这一能力通过递增更新算法得到进一步加强，该算法确保了新数据的及时整合，使该系统能够在迅速变化的数据环境中保持效力和反应能力。与现有方法相比，广泛的实验验证表明，检索的准确性和效率有相当大的提高。我们开放了我们的LightRAG的源代码，可在以下链接获取：https://github.com/HKUDS/LightRAG。

items.detail: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) has proven to be an effective tool for post-training language models (LMs). However, AI systems are increasingly expressed as modular programs that mix together multiple LM calls with distinct prompt templates and other tools, and it is not clear how best to leverage GRPO to improve these systems. We begin to address this challenge by defining mmGRPO, a simple multi-module generalization of GRPO that groups LM calls by module across rollouts and handles variable-length and interrupted trajectories. We find that mmGRPO, composed with automatic prompt optimization, improves accuracy by 11% on average across classification, many-hop search, and privacy-preserving delegation tasks against the post-trained LM, and by 5% against prompt optimization on its own. We open-source mmGRPO in DSPy as the dspy.GRPO optimizer.
items.title_zh: 多模块 GRPO：语言模型程序构建政策梯度和快速优化
items.detail_zh: 团体相对政策优化(GRPO)已被证明是培训后语言模型的有效工具。然而，AI系统越来越多地被表述为模块化程序，将多个LM调用组合在一起，并带有独特的即时模板和其他工具，目前尚不清楚如何最佳地利用GRPO来改进这些系统。我们开始通过定义mmGRPO来应对这一挑战，这是一个简单的GRPO的多模块概括，LM组通过模块逐个调用，处理可变长度和被中断的轨迹。我们发现由自动快速优化组成的 mmGRPO 提高了准确度 11% 跨分类，多跳搜索，和隐私保护任务 后训练的 LM，以及5% 的 自身快速优化。我们在DSPY开源的mmGRPO作为dspy。 GPRO优化器。

items.title: WorldLeague: Benchmarking Physical Agency

items.detail: AI systems can now operate Blender, follow instructions in complex video games, and manipulate objects with robot arms. What range of physical goals can today's AI systems achieve autonomously? Answering this question requires testing systems on tasks that demand different combinations of perception, memory, planning, and action. We introduce WorldLeague, a benchmark that compares AI systems on a common set of 60 simulated robot tasks by measuring progress toward each task's physical goal from the robot's trajectory. Robots explore scenes to gather evidence in WorldSeek, rearrange objects in WorldShape, and adapt to changes in WorldShift. Tying these goals to a single control interface limits which AI systems can be compared. In WorldLeague, vision-language models (VLMs) choose targets and motions, while vision-language-action models (VLAs) and world-action models (WAMs) use their native controls. For each of six capability dimensions, we measure how much progress a system makes toward its goals (Interactive Score) and how often it achieves them (physical success rate). Together, these measures form the system's Physical Agency Profile. Among 13 representative AI systems, Claude Fable 5.2 achieves 13 of the 60 goals and earns the highest mean Interactive Score (28.58/100). Fable leads in four dimensions, while GPT-6.1-Sol and GPT-6-Astra tie for first on rule-following tasks. Even when VLMs answer every final question correctly, they receive an Interactive Score of zero in 71.8\% of those episodes. WorldLeague gives Embodied AI, Physical AI, and Agentic AI a shared basis for comparing what AI systems achieve autonomously, from partial progress toward a physical goal to full goal completion. Project Webpage: https://xyangzhou.github.io/WorldLeague
items.title_zh: 世界游说：物质机构基准
items.detail_zh: AI系统现在可以操作Blender，在复杂的电子游戏中遵循指令，并用机器人手臂来操纵物体。今天的AI系统能自主地实现什么样的物理目标？回答这个问题需要测试系统来测试需要不同组合的认知，记忆，规划和行动的任务。我们引入了WorldLeague，这个基准通过从机器人的轨迹中测量每个任务物理目标的进展，来比较通用的60个模拟机器人任务中的AI系统。机器人探索场景，以收集出WorldSeek中的证据，重排出WorldShape中的对象，并适应WorldShift中的变化。将这些目标与AI系统可以比较的单一控制接口限制挂钩。在"WorldLeague"中，视觉语言模型(VLMs)选择了目标和运动，而视觉语言行动模型(VLAs)和世界行动模型(WAMS)则使用其本土控制。就六个能力层面而言，我们衡量一个系统在实现各项目标(互动得分)方面取得多大进展，以及实现目标的频率(实际成功率)。这些措施共同构成该系统的物理机构概况。在13个具有代表性的AI系统中，克洛德Fable 5.2实现了60个入球中的13个并获得最高的中位数"互动分数"(28.58/100)。有线在四个维度中领先，而GPT-6.1-Sol和GPT-6-Astra的平分则首先用于遵循规则的任务。即使在VLMs正确回答每个最后的问题时，他们也会在其中的71.8QQ中收到0的交互分数。 WorldLeague为人工智能、物理AI和Agentic AI提供了一个共同的基础，可以比较人工智能系统自主实现的目标，从部分实现物理目标到完全完成目标。项目网页：https://xyangzhou.github.io/ WorldLeague

items.detail: Trained action policies write manipulation skill into network weights, tying what is learned to the distribution it is learned from. In-context learning (ICL) avoids this coupling but has not matched trained policies, because a demonstration recorded in another scene carries no feedback from the world the robot currently faces. We observe that what an agent learns in context is semantic, recording task steps and object roles rather than visual appearance, so experience gathered in one world transfers to another. Based on this insight, we propose World In-Context Learning (WICL), a paradigm in which a frozen model starts from a demonstration, rehearses the task in a world such as a simulator, and writes the feedback into its context rather than its weights. We build RoboScript, a modular infrastructure that implements WICL for agentic manipulation. From a single demonstration, RoboScript learns each task through rehearsal in simulation, freezes the learned knowledge as a Task Memory, and deploys the frozen memory on new scenes with data isolation that ensures every deployment input is available on a real robot. On all 50 tasks of RoboTwin 2.0, RoboScript reaches 83.4% mean success across clean and randomized settings with one demonstration per task and no gradient updates, exceeding the strongest trained action policy by over 20 points. The method generalizes across visual distributions, improves through reflection, scales with the foundation model, and transfers to a physical dual-arm robot through cross-embodiment memory adaptation. With a world in the loop, a robot can learn a manipulation task in its context as well as it learns one in its weights. All code is available at https://github.com/ArcheOne-AI/RoboScript
items.title_zh: 用于代理机器人操纵的世界语境学习
items.detail_zh: 训练有素的行动政策将操控技巧写入网络权重，将所学到的与所学到的分布挂钩。内语学习(ICL)避免了这种耦合，但并没有匹配训练有素的政策，因为另一场景中记录的演示没有从机器人目前面对的世界中获得任何反馈。我们观察到，一个代理人在上下文中学到的是语义学，记录任务步骤和对象角色而不是视觉外观，所以在一个世界中积累的经验转移到另一个世界。基于这种洞察力，我们提出"世界内文学习"(WICL)这个范例，一个被冷冻的模型从演示开始，在模拟器这样的世界里排练任务，把反馈写进它的背景而不是它的权重。我们建造了RoboScript，一个模块化的基础设施，用于执行WICL的代理操纵。从一次演示中，RoboScript通过模拟的排练来学习每个任务，将学到的知识冻结为任务记忆，并将冻结的内存部署在新场景上，数据隔离可以确保每个部署输入都可用在真正的机器人上。在RoboTwin 2.0的所有50项任务中，RoboScript达到83.4%，意味着在干净和随机的设置中取得成功，每个任务一次演示，没有梯度更新，超过训练最强的行动政策超过20分。这种方法概括了视觉分布，通过反射改进，与基础模型的尺度化，并通过交叉化的内存适应向物理双臂机器人转移。有了循环的世界，机器人就可以在上下文中学习操纵任务，也可以在重量上学习。所有代码均可在https://github.com/ArcheOne-AI/RoboScript查阅

items.detail: Recent text-to-video diffusion models can generate compelling video sequences, yet they remain silent -- missing the semantic, emotional, and atmospheric cues that audio provides. We introduce LTX-2, an open-source foundational model capable of generating high-quality, temporally synchronized audiovisual content in a unified manner. LTX-2 consists of an asymmetric dual-stream transformer with a 14B-parameter video stream and a 5B-parameter audio stream, coupled through bidirectional audio-video cross-attention layers with temporal positional embeddings and cross-modality AdaLN for shared timestep conditioning. This architecture enables efficient training and inference of a unified audiovisual model while allocating more capacity for video generation than audio generation. We employ a multilingual text encoder for broader prompt understanding and introduce a modality-aware classifier-free guidance (modality-CFG) mechanism for improved audiovisual alignment and controllability. Beyond generating speech, LTX-2 produces rich, coherent audio tracks that follow the characters, environment, style, and emotion of each scene -- complete with natural background and foley elements. In our evaluations, the model achieves state-of-the-art audiovisual quality and prompt adherence among open-source systems, while delivering results comparable to proprietary models at a fraction of their computational cost and inference time. All model weights and code are publicly released.
items.title_zh: LTX-2：高效联合视听基础模型
items.detail_zh: 最近的文字到视频传播模型可以产生令人信服的视频序列，然而它们却保持沉默——缺少音频提供的语义，情感和大气提示。我们采用LTX-2，是一种开源基础模型，能够以统一的方式生成高质量，时间同步的视听内容。 LTX-2由非对称双流变压器组成，具有14B参数的视频流和5B参数的音频流，通过双向音频-视频交叉透视层结合而成，具有时间定位嵌入和跨模式的AdaLN用于共享时序调节。这种结构能够有效培训和推论统一的视听模式，同时分配比音频生成更多的视频生成能力。我们使用多语种文本编码器，以便迅速获得更广泛的理解，并采用一种无模式识别的分类器指导(模式-CFG)机制，以改进视听协调和可控性。 LTX-2除了生成语音外，还产生丰富，连贯的音频音轨，跟踪每个场景的人物，环境，风格和情感——完整地带有自然背景和foley元素。在我们的评价中，该模式实现了最先进的视听质量，并使开源系统迅速遵守，同时以占其计算成本和推断时间的一小部分，提供与专有模式可比的成果。所有模型重量和代码都公开发布。

items.detail: Data-centric training has emerged as a promising direction for improving large language models (LLMs) by optimizing not only model parameters but also the selection, composition, and weighting of training data during optimization. However, existing approaches to data selection, data mixture optimization, and data reweighting are often developed in isolated codebases with inconsistent interfaces, hindering reproducibility, fair comparison, and practical integration. In this paper, we present DataFlex, a unified data-centric dynamic training framework built upon LLaMA-Factory. DataFlex supports three major paradigms of dynamic data optimization: sample selection, domain mixture adjustment, and sample reweighting, while remaining fully compatible with the original training workflow. It provides extensible trainer abstractions and modular components, enabling a drop-in replacement for standard LLM training, and unifies key model-dependent operations such as embedding extraction, inference, and gradient computation, with support for large-scale settings including DeepSpeed ZeRO-3. We conduct comprehensive experiments across multiple data-centric methods. Dynamic data selection consistently outperforms static full-data training on MMLU across both Mistral-7B and Llama-3.2-3B. For data mixture, DoReMi and ODM improve both MMLU accuracy and corpus-level perplexity over default proportions when pretraining Qwen2.5-1.5B on SlimPajama at 6B and 30B token scales. DataFlex also achieves consistent runtime improvements over original implementations. These results demonstrate that DataFlex provides an effective, efficient, and reproducible infrastructure for data-centric dynamic training of LLMs.
items.title_zh: DataFlex：大语言模型数据-儿童动态培训的统一框架
items.detail_zh: 以数据为中心的培训已成为改进大型语言模型的有希望的方向，不仅优化了模型参数，而且在优化期间优化了培训数据的选择、组成和权重。然而，数据选择、数据混合物优化和数据再加权的现有方法常常是在接口不一致的孤立代码库中开发的，阻碍了可复制性、公平比较和实际的整合。在本文中，我们介绍了DataFlex，这是一个基于LLaMA-Factory的以数据为中心的统一动态培训框架。 DataFlex支持动态数据优化的三个主要范式：样本选择，域相混合调整，和样本再加权，同时保持与原始培训工作流程完全相容。它提供了可扩展的教练抽象和模块化组件，使得标准LLM培训能够被滴入替换，并统一了嵌入取取出，推论，梯度计算等关键依赖模型的操作，支持包括DeepSpeed ZeRO-3在内的大规模设置。我们通过多种以数据为中心的方法进行综合实验。动态数据选择在Mistral-7B和Llama-3.2-3B两地的MMLU的静态全数据培训上都一直超过业绩。对于数据混合物，当在SlimPajama上以6B和30B符号标尺预先训练Quen2.5-1.5B时，DoRemi和ODM既能提高MMLU的准确度，又能提高实体水平的复杂度，使其高于默认比例。 DataFlex还实现了与原始执行相比的一致运行时间改进。这些结果表明，DataFlex为LLMs的数据中心动态培训提供了有效、高效和可复制的基础设施。

items.detail: What if a world simulation model could render not an imagined environment but a city that actually exists? Prior generative world models synthesize visually plausible yet artificial environments by imagining all content. We present Seoul World Model (SWM), a city-scale world model grounded in the real city of Seoul. SWM anchors autoregressive video generation through retrieval-augmented conditioning on nearby street-view images. However, this design introduces several challenges, including temporal misalignment between retrieved references and the dynamic target scene, limited trajectory diversity and data sparsity from vehicle-mounted captures at sparse intervals. We address these challenges through cross-temporal pairing, a large-scale synthetic dataset enabling diverse camera trajectories, and a view interpolation pipeline that synthesizes coherent training videos from sparse street-view images. We further introduce a Virtual Lookahead Sink to stabilize long-horizon generation by continuously re-grounding each chunk to a retrieved image at a future location. We evaluate SWM against recent video world models across three cities: Seoul, Busan, and Ann Arbor. SWM outperforms existing methods in generating spatially faithful, temporally consistent, long-horizon videos grounded in actual urban environments over trajectories reaching hundreds of meters, while supporting diverse camera movements and text-prompted scenario variations.
items.title_zh: 将世界模拟模型放置在现实世界大都会
items.detail_zh: 如果一个世界模拟模型不能使一个想象的环境变成一个实际存在的城市呢？之前的基因世界模型通过想象所有内容来合成可视的但又人工的环境。我们提出汉城世界模型，这是建立在真正城市首尔的城市规模世界模型。 SWM主播通过在附近的街景图像上进行取回-增强调取来自动地生成视频。然而，这种设计带来了若干挑战，包括检索到的参考文献与动态目标场景之间的时间错位，轨迹多样性有限，以及从车载捕捉到的相去甚远的数据堆积。我们通过跨时空对接、大规模合成数据集，使各种相机轨迹成为可能，以及从稀少的街景图像中合成一致培训视频的取景插管，来应对这些挑战。我们进一步引入了虚拟Lookahead Sink，以稳定长视距的生成，不断将每个块重新定位到未来地点的取回图像。我们对照三个城市(首尔、釜山和Ann Arbor)的最新视频世界模式， SWM在生成空间上忠实、时间上一致、长视距的视频方面超越了现有方法，这些视频以实际城市环境为基础，超过了数百米的轨迹，同时支持各种相机移动和文本提示的情景变化。
