items.detail: Large language models have made research ideation increasingly accessible, yet effective idea development requires more than generating candidate directions. Researchers must ground a problem in current literature, identify meaningful bottlenecks, differentiate from existing solutions, and evaluate risks before committing to implementation. We present ResearchStudio-Idea as a reusable skill suite for this first mile of research ideation. The suite includes Paper-Search, a standalone multi-source literature search skill; Scoop-Check, a standalone prior-art collision checker for novelty claims; and IdeaSpark, the end-to-end skill that composes evidence grounding, pattern-guided generation, collision retrieval, audit, and idea-card rendering into one workflow. IdeaSpark is constructed from a corpus of 1,947 machine learning conference papers collected from ICLR, ICML, and NeurIPS between 2021 and 2025, including Oral papers, a separately tracked high-citation subset, and rejected submissions. Analysis of these outcomes reveals 31 recurring ideation sub-patterns, consolidated into 15 reusable ideation patterns. Each pattern is operationalized as a structured card containing research contexts, bottleneck types, differentiation strategies, supporting precedents, and common failure modes. Given a research problem and an evidence bundle, IdeaSpark evaluates evidence readiness, reconstructs the surrounding research context, identifies unresolved bottlenecks, selects relevant patterns, instantiates one candidate direction, retrieves potentially conflicting prior work, and performs outcome-informed auditing. This workflow transforms reusable ideation patterns into traceable research proposals. Blind automated-judge evaluations show that IdeaSpark consistently produces stronger research proposals than no-skill and generic-skill baselines while maintaining competitive novelty.
items.title_zh: 研究 -- -- 思想：由证据组成的研究 -- -- 技能设计套件，取自《多边法律公报》会议成果
items.detail_zh: 大型语言模型使得研究思想越来越容易获得，然而有效的思想发展需要的不仅仅是产生候选方向。研究人员必须在目前的文献中找出问题，找出有意义的瓶颈，区别现有解决办法，并在承诺执行之前评估风险。我们提出"研究-思想"(ResearchStudio-Idea)，作为这个第一英里研究设想的可重复使用的技能套件。套件包括：独立多源文献搜索技能Paper-Search；Scoop-Check，为新颖性索赔的独立前作碰撞检查器；以及IdeaSpark，即将证据搁浅，图案制导生成，碰撞检索，审计，和想法卡渲染成一个工作流程的端到端技能。 IdeaSpark由2021年至2025年间从ICLR、ICML和NeurIPS收集的1,947份机器学习会议文件组成，其中包括口述论文、单独跟踪的高引号子集以及被拒绝的提交。对这些结果的分析揭示了31个反复出现的思想副标本，合并为15个可重复使用的思想模式。每种模式作为结构化的卡片运作，包含研究背景、瓶颈类型、区分战略、支持先例和常见故障模式。鉴于一个研究问题和证据捆绑，IdeaSpark评价证据准备情况，重建周围的研究背景，找出尚未解决的瓶颈，选择相关模式，即时分析一个候选方向，检索可能相互冲突的先前工作，并进行成果知情的审计。这种工作流程将可重复使用的思想模式转化为可追踪的研究建议。盲目自动裁判员评价显示，IdeaSpark在保持竞争性新颖性的同时，不断产生比无技能和通用技能基线更强大的研究建议。

items.detail: Data agents aim to fulfill natural-language instructions over heterogeneous data, including tables, files, and databases. However, data agents face a challenging agent-data gap: heterogeneous data resides outside the agent, while the agent can access it (e.g., column names and file paths) only through generic tools. Existing approaches either let agents directly explore raw data sources or inject manually constructed semantic layers into prompts. However, neither scales well to large heterogeneous data sources nor adapts to different agent behaviors. In this paper, we introduce EvoOntology, a self-evolving ontology layer for data agents. EvoOntology encapsulates the ontology as an MCP server comprising a schema layer, a content layer, and a tool layer, enabling agents to actively query and interact with the ontology at runtime. To this end, we introduce a builder agent for autonomous ontology construction and a self-evolution loop that continuously refines the ontology through attribution-guided typed edits that are accepted only after a backbone-conditional paired evaluation. Experiments on three well-adopted data-agent benchmarks with four LLM backbones demonstrate that EvoOntology consistently outperforms strong baselines and existing semantic-layer approaches, effectively bridging the agent-data gap and enabling more effective interaction with heterogeneous data. Code: https://github.com/ruc-datalab/EvoOntology
items.title_zh: EvoOntology：数据代理自演的地层
items.detail_zh: 数据代理人旨在完成关于不同数据的自然语言指令，包括表格、文件和数据库。然而，数据代理面临着一个具有挑战性的代理数据缺口：不同数据存在于代理外，而代理只能通过通用工具才能访问它(例如列名和文件路径)。现有方法要么让代理直接探索原始数据源，要么将人工构造的语义层注入提示。然而，无论是对大数据来源的衡量都不好，对不同的代理行为也不适应。在本文中，我们引入了EvoOntology，一个数据代理的自演性肿瘤层。 EvoOntology将本体学封装为MCP服务器，由一个计划层，内容层，工具层组成，使代理在运行时能够积极查询并和本体学互动。为此，我们引入了自主肿瘤学建设的构建者代理和自演循环，通过归属引导的编目，不断完善肿瘤学，只有在骨干条件成对评价后才被接受。对三个通过得当的数据代理基准和四个LLM主干线进行的实验表明，EvoOntology一直比强基线和现有的语义层方法要好，有效地弥合了代理数据差距并使得能够与各种数据进行更有效的互动。代码：https://github.com/ruc-datalab/EvoOntology 互联网档案馆的存檔，存档日期2013-12-21。

items.title: Prime Agent: A Self-Improving RLM Harness

items.detail: Language models are sequential processors, but long-horizon agency requires external information and computation beyond model weights and active context. Prime Agent is an open-source harness for long-horizon evaluation and coding-agent workflows. A persistent IPython REPL follows the Recursive Language Model abstraction for programmatic context processing and test-time compute, while Continual Harness preserves histories, memories, skills, prompts, and subagent specifications across trajectories. Recursive subagents coordinate through direct agent-to-agent communication, and the Agents View lets humans inspect and manage daemon-backed sessions. Prime Agent standardizes execution, recovery, verification, and resource accounting while leaving strategy construction to the model. This low-friction, expressive membrane prevents harness failures from becoming model failures and pushes measurement toward the model's true maximal underlying capability. Prime Agent raises ARC-AGI-3 RHAE Best@1 from 30% to 95.5% and matches or exceeds native and popular harnesses across long-context coding, GPU-kernel generation, emulator construction, and autonomous nanoGPT speedruns. On Factorio, we find refinement allows for continuous technology progression and dedicated subagents enable parallelized work. Code is available at https://github.com/PrimeIntellect-ai/prime-agent.
items.title_zh: 主干员：自我改进的 RLM 技巧
items.detail_zh: 语言模型是相继的处理器，但长视机构需要外部信息并进行超出模型权重和活性上下文的计算。 Prime Agent是用于长视评价和编码代理工作流程的开源控制器。持续的IPython REPL遵循了Recursive Language Model的抽象，用于程序上下文处理和测试时间计算，而Continual Harness则保存了历史，记忆，技能，提示，和跨道的子剂规格。递归子剂通过直接代理对代理通信来协调，代理视图让人类检查和管理守护进程支持的会话。主干员将执行、恢复、核查和资源核算标准化，同时将战略构建留给模型。这种低温的显性薄膜防止了操纵故障成为模型故障，并将测量推向模型真正的最大基础能力。 Prime Agent将ARC-AGI-3 RHAE Best@1从30%提升到95.5%，并在长文本编码、GPU-内核生成、模拟器构建和自主纳米GPT快跑中匹配或超过本地和受欢迎的牵引。在Instemio上，我们发现改进可以使技术不断进步，专用的子剂可以使工作并行。代码见https://github.com/PrimeIntellect-ai/prime-agent。

items.detail: Human demonstrations provide a rich source of bimanual dexterous skills, yet transferring them to robot hands remains challenging. Existing methods primarily optimize object trajectory tracking, often overlooking how human hands interact with the object. Even with accurate tracking, robots may contact incorrect object parts or slide their fingers, resulting in unstable manipulation. We present DexDuet, a framework that learns contact-preserving bimanual dexterity from a single human demonstration. DexDuet employs two interaction rewards to preserve human hand-object configurations and contacts. To enable coordinated manipulation, we factorize the bimanual policy into two weight-sharing per-hand policies that condition on each other's states. We further propose assisted reference-state initialization (A-RSI), an adaptive curriculum that adjusts object assistance and training starts across demonstration segments to overcome difficult manipulation phases. Across four benchmarks spanning three simulators and five robot embodiments, DexDuet improves object-tracking ADD-AUC by 11 to 41 points over the corresponding baselines while consistently achieving better contact preservation. Notably, among 122 paired runs with comparable object-tracking accuracy, DexDuet preserves the human's contacts better in 117 cases. Code and videos are available at https://rcl-robotics.github.io/Dexduet.io/
items.title_zh: DexDuet：学习接触-从人类示威中保留双人字词
items.detail_zh: 人类的示威提供了丰富的双人性德克思特技能来源，而将其转移给机器人手仍然具有挑战性。现有方法主要是优化物体轨迹跟踪，经常会俯瞰人手与物体的相互作用。即使有精确的跟踪，机器人也可能接触不正确的物体部件或滑动手指，导致操纵不稳定。我们介绍DexDuet，这个框架从人类的一次演示中学习到 保持接触的双动性。 DexDuet使用两个交互奖励来保存人类的手对象配置和接触。为了能够协调操纵，我们将双人政策纳入两个以各自国家为条件的分量政策。我们进一步提议协助参考状态初始化(A-RSI)，这是调整对象援助和培训的适应性课程，从示范阶段开始，以克服困难的操纵阶段。 DexDuet在跨越三个模拟器和五个机器人化器的4个基准中，将物体跟踪ADD-AUC比相应基线改进了11至41分，同时始终实现更好的接触保护。值得注意的是，在122个对接的跟踪精确度相当的跑道中，DexDuet在117个案例中更好地保持了人类接触。守则和录像可在https://rcl-robotics.github.io/Dexduet.io/上查阅。

items.detail: Most world models for future prediction prioritize aestetic quality of generated videos, but offer only weak physical grounding and limited geometric consistency over time, due to the lack of explicit 4D modeling. In this paper, we introduce plan4d, a possible next milestone towards building a generative plannable 4D world model that predicts future RGB videos together with dense 4D geometry, including depth, cameras, point clouds, and scene flow from an observed scene context and text-specified actions. Since training data with paired actions and dense 4D annotations is inherently scarce, plan4d leverages the complementary priors of foundational video generators and 3D reconstructors. Specifically, we propose a model-stitching architecture that couples Depth Anything 3 with LongCat-Video and augments it with an auxiliary DPT head for scene-flow prediction. The resulting model allows us to plan and generate complex, long-horizon, and fine-grained actions in a dynamic 3D scenes, while substantially improving both visual fidelity and geometric accuracy of the generated future videos. Extensive experiments on both synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate that plan4d achieves state-of-the-art performance in generative 4D modeling of environmental reactions. Project Page: https://fogradio.github.io/plan4d-project

items.detail_zh: 大多数用于未来预测的世界模型优先考虑生成的视频的地表质量，但由于缺乏明确的4D模型，只能提供薄弱的物理地基和一段时间内有限的几何一致性。在本文中，我们引入了plan4d，这是建立一个基因可规划的4D世界模型的下一个可能里程碑，该模型将预测未来RGB视频与密集的4D几何，包括深度，相机，点云，以及从被观测到的场景背景和文字指定动作中流出场景。由于配对动作和密集的4D说明的训练数据本来就稀缺，所以Plan4d利用了基础视频生成器和3D重建器的互补前身。具体地说，我们提出一个模型-跳槽架构，让"深度"(Anything 3)与"长卡特-视频"(LongCat-Video)相配，并用一个辅助的DPT头来进行场景流预测。由此形成的模型使我们能够在动态的3D场景中策划和生成复杂，长视距，精细的动作，同时大幅度地提高所生成的未来视频的视觉忠诚度和几何精度。对合成和现实世界数据集的广泛实验表明，plan4d在环境反应的基因4D模型化中实现了最先进的性能。项目网页：https://fogradio.github.io/plan4d-project

items.detail: Diffusion language models (DLMs) offer parallel sampling for faster generation than autoregressive models, an increasingly important advantage as inference becomes a dominant computational workload. However, DLMs degrade quickly with fewer sampling steps, process the full sequence at every step, and require many passes over the dataset to reach good quality. We introduce Next-Concept Modeling (NCM), a two-stage, coarse-to-fine framework: a multiscale residual VQ-VAE encodes text into a hierarchy of discrete codes, and a transformer generates one level at a time, predicting all codes within a level in parallel. At matched parameter scales, NCM achieves better generative perplexity than the strongest DLM baseline on LM1B while running 21times faster. On OpenWebText, NCM is competitive with the strongest DLM while running 10times faster; on XSum, it matches the strongest DLM's ROUGE-L while being 31times faster. On the reasoning task of Sudoku, NCM outperforms autoregressive and diffusion baselines across all difficulty levels, using fewer function evaluations. On the reasoning task of Sudoku, NCM outperforms autoregressive and diffusion baselines across all difficulty levels, using fewer function evaluations.

items.detail: Financial sentiment analysis is critical for valuation and investment decision-making. Traditional NLP models, however, are limited by their parameter size and the scope of their training datasets, which hampers their generalization capabilities and effectiveness in this field. Recently, Large Language Models (LLMs) pre-trained on extensive corpora have demonstrated superior performance across various NLP tasks due to their commendable zero-shot abilities. Yet, directly applying LLMs to financial sentiment analysis presents challenges: The discrepancy between the pre-training objective of LLMs and predicting the sentiment label can compromise their predictive performance. Furthermore, the succinct nature of financial news, often devoid of sufficient context, can significantly diminish the reliability of LLMs' sentiment analysis. To address these challenges, we introduce a retrieval-augmented LLMs framework for financial sentiment analysis. This framework includes an instruction-tuned LLMs module, which ensures LLMs behave as predictors of sentiment labels, and a retrieval-augmentation module which retrieves additional context from reliable external sources. Benchmarked against traditional models and LLMs like ChatGPT and LLaMA, our approach achieves 15\% to 48\% performance gain in accuracy and F1 score.

items.detail: Complex software systems develop over timescales that exceed the lifespan of any individual coding agent. Most agentic software systems preserve continuity through persistent sessions, memories, managers or shared context. We introduce EvoX Genesis (hereafter, Genesis), which instead makes the software project persistent while allowing local agents to remain finite-lived. Genesis represents software as a persistent recursive world: each local world is situated by an accepted version and a repository path, finite-lived agents propose local changes, recursive delegation moves work across paths, and only accepted consequences advance the persistent version history. We evaluate this organization across formation, continuation and redevelopment. Starting from a repository with no compiler implementation, Genesis used DeepSeek V4 Flash to build a Rust-based C compiler with about 250k tracked lines; the run lasted over 120 hours, archived over 1,000 agent episodes and incurred only US$44 in model-token charges. The compiler passed the complete c-testsuite and most LLVM and Csmith tests. In a separate compiler world generated with GLM 5.2, development continued after repeated agent replacement while retaining full test performance. Genesis also reimplemented 13 MESA modules with over 100k Fortran lines as a Rust workspace with nearly 90k Rust lines; across six numerical workloads, it achieved median speedups of 1.55--6.87x. These results show that long-horizon software development can be organized around a persistent project rather than a persistent agent.
items.title_zh: 持续递录世界启用自动软件进化
items.detail_zh: 复杂的软件系统在时间尺度上发展，超过任何单个编码代理的寿命。大多数代理软件系统通过持续的会话，记忆，管理者或共享上下文来保持连续性。我们介绍EvoX创世纪(以下简称创世纪)，它使得软件项目具有持久性，同时允许本地代理保持有限的寿命。创世纪代表软件是一个持久的递归世界：每个当地世界都有一个公认的版本和一个寄存路径，有限的寿命代理提出局部变化，递归授权移动跨路径工作，只有公认的后果才能推进持久性版本的历史。我们评价这个组织在组建、延续和重新发展等各个方面。从一个没有编译器执行的寄存器开始，创世纪利用DeepSeek V4 Flash来建造一个基于Rust的C编译器，有约250k的履带线；运行持续了120多小时，存档超过1000个代理事件，只花费44美元进行模型化收费。编译器通过了完整的c测试套装和大多数LLVM和Csmith测试。在一个用GLM 5.2生成的单独的编译器世界中，在重复代理替换后继续开发，同时保留完整的测试性能。创世纪还重新实施了13个MESA模块，超过100k的Fortran线作为Rust工作空间，有近90k的Rust线；在6个数字工作量中，实现了1.55-6.87x的中位速。这些结果表明，长视距软件开发可以围绕一个持久的项目而不是一个持久的代理来组织。

items.detail: We introduce Agent2 RL-Bench, a compact diagnostic benchmark for evaluating agentic RL post-training, which tests whether LLM agents can autonomously design, implement, debug, and execute post-training pipelines that improve foundation models. RL post-training increasingly drives model alignment and specialization, yet existing benchmarks are largely static, rewarding supervised fine-tuning or script generation without assessing an agent's ability to close an interactive RL loop. Agent2 RL-Bench provides a unified agent-facing interface: each run starts from an isolated workspace containing a base model, task data, instructions, and a grading API, and agents must iterate within a fixed budget by training models and submitting artifacts for evaluation. The benchmark spans six tasks across three levels, from static rule-based training to judge-based optimization and closed-loop online RL with trajectory collection. Two diagnostic skills, namely runtime recording and post-hoc summarization, enable structured analysis of agent behavior, facilitating smooth and effective iteration of the benchmark's evaluation framework. Across five agent systems and six driver LLMs, agents show intelligent behavior but clear limitations: one RL-oriented run improves ALFWorld from 4.85 to 93.28 via SFT warm-up and GRPO with online rollouts, yet DeepSearchQA remains difficult, most successful routes rely on supervised pipelines, and interactive outcomes show large single-run differences across agent stacks. Overall, Agent2 RL-Bench shows that current agents can sometimes engineer online RL, but stable agent-driven RL post-training remains rare under fixed budgets. It also demonstrates that our benchmark provides a strong and effective evaluation framework for future research in this direction. Code is available at https://github.com/microsoft/RD-Agent/blob/main/rdagent/scenarios/rl/autorl_bench/README.md
items.title_zh: 代理 ^2 RL-Bench： LLM代理 工程师 代理 RL 后训练？
items.detail_zh: 我们引入了Agent2 RL-Bench，这是一个用于评价代理RL后训练的紧凑诊断基准，该基准测试LLM代理是否能够自主设计，执行，调试，以及执行改进基础模型的训练后管道。 RL后培训日益推动模式的调整和专业化，但现有的基准基本上是静态的，奖励有监督的微调或脚本生成，而不评估代理商关闭交互RL环的能力。 Agent2 RL-Bench提供了统一的代理-造型接口：每次运行都从一个孤立的工作空间开始，包含一个基础模型，任务数据，指令，以及一个分级的API，代理必须在固定预算范围内通过培训模型进行迭代，并将文物提交评估。该基准跨越三个层面的6项任务，从静态的基于规则的培训到基于判断的优化和带有轨迹收集的闭路在线RL。两种诊断技能，即运行时间记录和模拟汇总后，能够对代理行为进行结构化分析，促进基准评价框架的平稳有效的迭代。在五个代理系统和六个驱动程序 LLMs 中，代理显示智能行为，但有明显的局限性：一个面向RL的运行通过SFT热身和GPRO改进了ALFWorld，从4.85到93.28，并在网上推出，然而DeepSearchQA仍然困难重重，大多数成功路线依赖于受监管的管道，互动结果显示代理堆之间的单运行差异很大。总体而言，Agent2 RL-Bench显示，现在的代理有时可以在线设计RL，但稳定代理驱动的RL后培训在固定预算下仍然罕见。它还表明，我们的基准为今后这方面的研究提供了有力和有效的评价框架。代码见https://github.com/microsoft/RD-Agent/blob/main/rdagent/scenarios/rl/autorl bench/README.md。

items.detail: This paper presents the design, implementation, and evaluation of the PyTorch distributed data parallel module. PyTorch is a widely-adopted scientific computing package used in deep learning research and applications. Recent advances in deep learning argue for the value of large datasets and large models, which necessitates the ability to scale out model training to more computational resources. Data parallelism has emerged as a popular solution for distributed training thanks to its straightforward principle and broad applicability. In general, the technique of distributed data parallelism replicates the model on every computational resource to generate gradients independently and then communicates those gradients at each iteration to keep model replicas consistent. Despite the conceptual simplicity of the technique, the subtle dependencies between computation and communication make it non-trivial to optimize the distributed training efficiency. As of v1.5, PyTorch natively provides several techniques to accelerate distributed data parallel, including bucketing gradients, overlapping computation with communication, and skipping gradient synchronization. Evaluations show that, when configured appropriately, the PyTorch distributed data parallel module attains near-linear scalability using 256 GPUs.
items.title_zh: PyTorch 分布：加速数据平行培训的经验
items.detail_zh: 本文件介绍了PyTorch分布式数据平行模块的设计、实施和评价。 PyTorch是一个被广泛采纳的科学计算包，用于深层学习研究和应用。最近深入学习的进展论证了大型数据集和大型模型的价值，这就要求有能力将模型培训扩大到更多的计算资源。由于数据平行原则的直截了当和广泛适用性，数据平行主义已成为分发培训的流行解决办法。一般来说，分布式数据平行技术在每一个计算资源上复制模型，独立生成梯度，然后在每个迭代上传达这些梯度，以保持模型复制的一致性。尽管技术在概念上是简单的，但计算和通信之间的微妙依赖性使得优化分布式培训效率成为非三角性。截至v1.5，PyTorch本土提供了几种加速分布式数据平行的技术，包括桶式梯度，与通信重叠计算，以及跳过梯度同步。评价显示，PyTorch分布式数据平行模块在适当配置时，使用256GPU实现近线性可扩展性。

items.detail: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly adapted to downstream tasks via reinforcement learning (RL) methods like Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), which often require thousands of rollouts to learn new tasks. We argue that the interpretable nature of language can often provide a much richer learning medium for LLMs, compared with policy gradients derived from sparse, scalar rewards. To test this, we introduce GEPA (Genetic-Pareto), a prompt optimizer that thoroughly incorporates natural language reflection to learn high-level rules from trial and error. Given any AI system containing one or more LLM prompts, GEPA samples system-level trajectories (e.g., reasoning, tool calls, and tool outputs) and reflects on them in natural language to diagnose problems, propose and test prompt updates, and combine complementary lessons from the Pareto frontier of its own attempts. As a result of GEPA's design, it can often turn even just a few rollouts into a large quality gain. Across four tasks, GEPA outperforms GRPO by 10% on average and by up to 20%, while using up to 35x fewer rollouts. GEPA also outperforms the leading prompt optimizer, MIPROv2, by over 10% across two LLMs, and demonstrates promising results as an inference-time search strategy for code optimization.

items.title: A decoder-only foundation model for time-series forecasting
items.subtitle: Motivated by recent advances in large language models for Natural Language Processing (NLP), we design a time-series foundation model for forecasting whose out-of-the-box zero-shot performance on a variety of public datasets comes close to the accuracy of state-of-the-art supervised forecasting models for each individual dataset. Our model is based on pretraining a patched-decoder style attention model on a large time-series corpus, and can work well across different forecasting history lengths, prediction lengths and temporal granularities.

items.detail: KV cache has traditionally been stored in GPU memory to accelerate the decoding phase of large language model (LLM) inference. However, it is increasingly necessary to move KV caches outside GPU devices, to enable cache reuse across different queries and inference engines. Our real-world usage statistics confirm this trend: over time, the total KV cache stored by users has grown rapidly, far exceeding the capacity of GPU memory. Despite this need, there lacks an efficient solution for offloading and transferring KV caches. We present LMCACHE, the first and so far the most efficient open-source KV caching solution, which extracts and stores KV caches generated by modern LLM engines (vLLM and SGLang) out of the GPU memory and shares them across engines and queries. LMCACHE supports both cache offloading (prefix reuse across queries) and prefill-decode (PD) disaggregation (cross-engine/GPU cache transfer). LMCACHE's high performance and wide adoption stem from the following contributions: (1) highly optimized KV cache data movement powered by batched data movement operations, compute and I/O pipelining; (2) a modular KV cache connector component, decoupling LMCACHE from the rapid evolution of inference engines; (3) a first-class control API for flexible cache orchestration across GPU, CPU, storage, and network layers. Our evaluation shows that combining LMCACHE with vLLM achieves up to 15x improvement in throughput across workloads such as multi-round question answering and document analysis. Large-scale adoption of LMCACHE in enterprise settings provides us valuable insights, for example, fetching KV cache from remote storage has unsurprisingly benefits to prefill delay, and that context truncation, which is a widely applied technique in industry, can greatly reduce prefix cache hit ratio by half. The source code of LMCACHE is at: https://github.com/LMCache/LMCache.
items.title_zh: LMCach：企业规模 LLM 的高效 KV 缓存层 推论
items.detail_zh: KV缓存传统上存储在GPU内存中，以加速大语言模型(LLM)推论的解码阶段。然而，越来越有必要将 KV 缓存移到 GPU 设备之外，以便缓存在不同的查询和推论引擎中重复使用。我们的现实世界使用统计证实了这一趋势：随着时间的推移，用户存储的KV缓存总量迅速增长，远远超过了GPU内存的能力。尽管有这种需要，但对于卸载和转移KV缓存缺乏有效的解决方案。我们提出LMCACHE，这是第一个也是迄今为止效率最高的开源KV缓存解决方案，它从GPU内存中提取并存储现代LLM引擎(vLLM和SGLang)生成的KV缓存，并在引擎和查询中共享。 LMCACHE既支持缓存卸载(前缀重复使用跨查询)，也支持预填解码(PD)分类(cross-engine/GPU缓存传输)。 LMCACHE的高性能和广泛的采用来源于以下贡献：(1)通过批量数据移动操作，计算和I/O管线来进行高度优化的KV缓存数据移动；(2)一个模块化的KV缓存连接器组件，将LMCACHE与推论引擎的快速演化脱钩；(3)一个用于跨GPU，CPU，存储，和网络层灵活缓存管的一流控制API。我们的评价表明，将LMCACHE与vLLM相结合，在多轮问题回答和文件分析等工作量方面，可实现15倍的吞吐量改善。在企业环境中大规模采用LMCACHE，为我们提供了宝贵的见解，例如，从远程存储中获取KV缓存对预填延迟毫无意外的好处，这种上下文截断是工业中广泛应用的一种技术，可以大大降低前缀缓存命中率的一半。 LMCACHE的源代码见：https://github.com/LMCache/LMCache。

To narrow this gap, we introduce MOSS-Image, an open generation system that combines high-fidelity visual synthesis with intent-aware composition. First, we pretrain a 5B single-stream diffusion transformer (DiT) from scratch with a carefully designed recipe, enabling bilingual long-form text rendering and precise layout control. items.detail: Recent closed-source image generation systems can produce diverse visual content from simple compositions to information-dense graphics, yet open-weight text-to-image models still struggle with dense text and intricate layouts. To narrow this gap, we introduce MOSS-Image, an open generation system that combines high-fidelity visual synthesis with intent-aware composition. First, we pretrain a 5B single-stream diffusion transformer (DiT) from scratch with a carefully designed recipe, enabling bilingual long-form text rendering and precise layout control. Second, we develop an intention-aware agentic prompt enhancement (PE) module that translates diverse user requests into detailed content and layout specifications. Together, they enable MOSS-Image to generate text-rich and layout-coherent images. We further introduce LongLongTextBench (LLTB) for evaluating long-form English and Chinese text rendering, and RealLayoutArena (RLA) for end-to-end layout-rich generation. MOSS-Image achieves state-of-the-art performance among open-weight models on LLTB, with an average text coverage of 96.3%. On RLA, MOSS-Image ranks second in the end-to-end system comparison, while its backbone ranks first among generators evaluated with shared enhanced prompts. We will release the model, training recipe, and evaluation framework to support further research and promote the text-to-image community.
items.title_zh: 最低业务安全标准-图像技术报告
items.detail_zh: 最近的闭源图像生成系统可以产生从简单的组成到信息密集的图形的不同视觉内容，然而开放式的文本到图像模型仍然与密集的文本和复杂的布局相抗衡。为了缩小这一差距，我们引入了MOSS-Image，一种开放的生成系统，将高真性视觉合成与意向意识组成相结合。首先，我们用精心设计的食谱，从头开始预先训练5B型单流扩散变压器(DIT)，使双语长式文本渲染和精确布局控制成为可能。第二，我们开发了一个意向意识的即时增强(PE)模块，将不同的用户请求转化为详细的内容和布局规格。它们共同使MOSS-Image生成内容丰富且布局一致的图像。我们进一步引入了LongLongText Bench(LLTB)来评价长式英文和中文文本渲染，以及RealLayoutArena(RLA)来评价端到端布局丰富的一代。 MOSS-Image在LLTB上的开放量级模型中实现了最先进的性能，平均文本覆盖率为96.3%。在RALA方面，MOSS-Image在端对端系统比较中排名第二，而其骨干在使用共享增强提示器评价的发电机中排名第一。我们将发布模式、培训食谱和评价框架，以支持进一步研究，并促进文本到图像社区。

items.detail: We present SHARP, an approach to photorealistic view synthesis from a single image. Given a single photograph, SHARP regresses the parameters of a 3D Gaussian representation of the depicted scene. This is done in less than a second on a standard GPU via a single feedforward pass through a neural network. The 3D Gaussian representation produced by SHARP can then be rendered in real time, yielding high-resolution photorealistic images for nearby views. The representation is metric, with absolute scale, supporting metric camera movements. Experimental results demonstrate that SHARP delivers robust zero-shot generalization across datasets. It sets a new state of the art on multiple datasets, reducing LPIPS by 25-34% and DISTS by 21-43% versus the best prior model, while lowering the synthesis time by three orders of magnitude. Code and weights are provided at https://github.com/apple/ml-sharp

items.detail: Interactive video world models enable exploration through text and camera controls, yet direct object interaction requires finer control. Hands provide a natural interface, but translating continuous hand movements into coherent visual responses remains challenging because of complex hand-object dynamics and demanding real-time computation. To address these challenges, we introduce LynnReal-Hand, a hand-controlled video world model that unifies precise interaction modeling with efficient streaming generation. We curate 100K interaction clips spanning diverse real and synthetic environments and develop hand-aware supervision to improve fine-grained hand motions and object interactions. Building on this foundation, we learn a causal flow map for few-step generation and introduce region-aware score distillation that combines complementary video and image priors to refine interaction dynamics and visual appearance. To further reduce inference latency, we propose Ultra-Fast-VAE, a compact video decoder that preserves high reconstruction fidelity with substantially lower computational cost. Extensive evaluations on HandBench demonstrate superior hand-following accuracy and visual quality compared with existing approaches. Our full-sequence model achieves an FVD of 181.67 and a MANO Dice score of 93.02, while the three-step causal model maintains a MANO Dice score of 92.49. For real-time interaction, 540p streaming on a single H200 reaches 18.03 FPS with 741ms latency and an optimized peak GPU memory footprint of only 34.89GB. We will release the datasets, model weights, and the full training and inference code to support research on hand-controlled video world models.

items.detail_zh: 交互式视频世界模型通过文本和相机控制可以进行探索，然而直接对象交互需要更精细的控制。手提供了自然的界面，但将连续的手动转化为连贯的视觉反应仍然具有挑战性，因为手物体动态复杂，需要实时计算。为了应对这些挑战，我们引入了Lynn Real-Hand，这是一种手控视频世界模型，它统一了与高效流体生成的精确互动模型。我们控制了100K的相互作用片段，它们跨越不同的真实和合成环境，并发展手感监督，以改善精细的手动和物体相互作用。在这个基础上，我们学习了几步生成的因果流图，并引入了区域意识分数蒸馏法，结合了互补的视频和图像前传，以完善互动动态和视觉外观。为了进一步减少推论延迟，我们提议使用Ultra-Fast-VAE，这是一个紧凑的视频解码器，它能保持高的重建忠诚，并大大降低计算成本。对HandBench的广泛评价显示，与现有方法相比，手跟手的准确性和视觉质量更高。我们的全序模型实现了181.67的FVD和93.02的MANO Dice分数，而三步因果模型保持了92.49。对于实时交互，单H200上流的540p达到了18.03 FPS，有741ms的耐久性，最优化的顶峰GPU记忆足迹只有34.89GB。我们将发布数据集，模型权重，以及完整的培训和推论代码，以支持手控视频世界模型的研究。

items.detail: We present Hunyuan3D 2.0, an advanced large-scale 3D synthesis system for generating high-resolution textured 3D assets. This system includes two foundation components: a large-scale shape generation model -- Hunyuan3D-DiT, and a large-scale texture synthesis model -- Hunyuan3D-Paint. The shape generative model, built on a scalable flow-based diffusion transformer, aims to create geometry that properly aligns with a given condition image, laying a solid foundation for downstream applications. The texture synthesis model, benefiting from strong geometric and diffusion priors, produces high-resolution and vibrant texture maps for either generated or hand-crafted meshes. Furthermore, we build Hunyuan3D-Studio -- a versatile, user-friendly production platform that simplifies the re-creation process of 3D assets. It allows both professional and amateur users to manipulate or even animate their meshes efficiently. We systematically evaluate our models, showing that Hunyuan3D 2.0 outperforms previous state-of-the-art models, including the open-source models and closed-source models in geometry details, condition alignment, texture quality, and etc. Hunyuan3D 2.0 is publicly released in order to fill the gaps in the open-source 3D community for large-scale foundation generative models. The code and pre-trained weights of our models are available at: https://github.com/Tencent/Hunyuan3D-2
items.title_zh: Hunyuan3D 2.0：高分辨率文本化3D资产生成放大扩散模型
items.detail_zh: 我们介绍Hunyuan3D 2.0，这是一个高级的大型3D合成系统，用于生成高分辨率的文本化3D资产。这个系统包括两个基础组件：一个大规模形状生成模型-Hunyuan3D-DiT，和一个大规模纹理合成模型-Hunyuan3D-Paint。造型基因模型建立在可伸缩的流基扩散变速器上，旨在创造与特定条件图像适当对齐的几何学，为下游应用奠定了坚实的基础。纹理合成模型得益于强几何和传播前科，为生成的或手工制作的网盖制作高分辨率和充满活力的纹理图。此外，我们建造了Hunyuan3D-Studio -- -- 一个多功能、方便用户的生产平台，简化了3D资产的再创造过程。它使专业和业余用户能够有效地操纵甚至激活他们的网格。我们系统地评价我们的模型，显示Hunyuan3D 2.0比以前最先进的模型表现得更好，包括几何细节，条件对齐，纹理质量等方面的开源模型和闭源模型。 Hunyuan3D 2.0公开发布，以填补开源3D社区中用于大型基础基因模型的空白。我们的型号的代码和预先训练过的权重见https://github.com/Tencent/Hunyuan3D-2。

items.detail: Native 3D generation has largely been built around latent diffusion, with recent advances concentrating on stronger variational autoencoders (VAE) and increasingly elaborate latent representations, from vecset and triplanes to structured sparse voxels. Despite their architectural differences, these methods all share the same premise: geometry is first compressed into a latent space and only then modeled by the generator. We take a different route and propose Direct3D-V3, a latent-free diffusion transformer (DiT) framework that discards the VAE altogether and operates in the native voxel domain, directly modeling raw SDF voxel grids during both training and sampling. To make this direct voxel formulation geometrically reliable, we introduce an implicit manifold regularization over neighboring voxels to suppress non-watertight surfaces, and convert predicted SDF grids into meshes via Marching Cubes so that rendered normal losses can supervise the model directly from its predicted SDF. To improve alignment between the conditioning image and generated geometry, Direct3D-V3 also predicts the camera parameters of the conditioning image as an auxiliary task, encouraging the DiT to learn the mapping from image observations to 3D shape. This latent-free design removes the reconstruction bottleneck, brings training under an objective in the native voxel domain, and yields meshes with substantially richer local detail. The predicted camera and native SDF voxel output further make Direct3D-V3 extensible to generative reconstruction, where diffusion is interleaved with normal-guided refinement to improve alignment with the observed view while the generative prior completes unseen regions. Project page: https://dreamtechai.github.io/Direct3D-V3.
items.detail_zh: 原生的3D生成主要围绕潜在扩散，最近的进展集中于更强的变异自编码器(VAE)，并日益细化从维塞特和triclanes到结构化的稀疏的Voxel的潜在表示。尽管它们的建筑差异，这些方法都有一个相同的前提：几何首先被压缩成一个潜伏的空间，然后才由生成器模拟。我们采用不同的路线，提出Direct3D-V3，一种潜在的无扩散变压器(DIT)框架，将VAE完全丢弃，在原生的Voxel域内运行，在培训和取样期间直接模拟原始的SDF voxel网格。为了让这种直接的 voxel 配方几何上可靠，我们引入了一种隐含的多重规范 相对于邻邻的 voxel 来抑制非水密表面，通过 Marching Cube 将预测的 SDF 网格转换成 meshes，这样正常的丢失可以直接从它的预测 SDF 来监督模型。为了改进调制图像与生成几何的对齐，Direct3D-V3还预测了调制图像的相机参数作为辅助任务，鼓励DiT学习从图像观测到3D形状的绘图。这种潜在的无潜质设计消除了重建瓶颈，将培训置于本土毒物领域的一个目标之下，并产生更丰富的本地细节。预测的相机和原生的SDF voxel输出进一步使Direct3D-V3扩展至基因重建，其扩散与正常的制导改进相交，以更好地与观测到的观点保持一致，而基因先前完成的未见区域。项目页：https://dreamtechai.github.io/Direct3D-V3。

items.title: EvoScientist: Towards Multi-Agent Evolving AI Scientists for End-to-End Scientific Discovery
items.subtitle: The increasing adoption of Large Language Models (LLMs) has enabled AI scientists to perform complex end-to-end scientific discovery tasks requiring coordination of specialized roles, including idea generation and experimental execution. However, most state-of-the-art AI scientist systems rely on static, hand-designed pipelines and fail to adapt based on accumulated interaction histories. As a result, these systems overlook promising research directions, repeat failed experiments, and pursue infeasible ideas. items.detail: The increasing adoption of Large Language Models (LLMs) has enabled AI scientists to perform complex end-to-end scientific discovery tasks requiring coordination of specialized roles, including idea generation and experimental execution. However, most state-of-the-art AI scientist systems rely on static, hand-designed pipelines and fail to adapt based on accumulated interaction histories. As a result, these systems overlook promising research directions, repeat failed experiments, and pursue infeasible ideas. To address this, we introduce EvoScientist, an evolving multi-agent AI scientist framework that continuously improves research strategies through persistent memory and self-evolution. EvoScientist comprises three specialized agents: a Researcher Agent (RA) for scientific idea generation, an Engineer Agent (EA) for experiment implementation and execution, and an Evolution Manager Agent (EMA) that distills insights from prior interactions into reusable knowledge. EvoScientist contains two persistent memory modules: (i) an ideation memory, which summarizes feasible research directions from top-ranked ideas while recording previously unsuccessful directions; and (ii) an experimentation memory, which captures effective data processing and model training strategies derived from code search trajectories and best-performing implementations. These modules enable the RA and EA to retrieve relevant prior strategies, improving idea quality and code execution success rates over time. Experiments show that EvoScientist outperforms 7 open-source and commercial state-of-the-art systems in scientific idea generation, achieving higher novelty, feasibility, relevance, and clarity via automatic and human evaluation. EvoScientist also substantially improves code execution success rates through multi-agent evolution, demonstrating persistent memory's effectiveness for end-to-end scientific discovery.
items.title_zh: EvoScientist：走向多代理进化AI 科学家促进端到端科学发现
items.detail_zh: 越来越多的采用大语言模型(LLMs)使得AI科学家能够执行复杂的端到端科学发现任务，需要协调专门的角色，包括思想生成和实验执行。然而，大多数最先进的AI科学家系统都依赖于静态的，手工设计的管道，未能根据累积的相互作用历史进行适应。因此，这些系统忽略了有希望的研究方向，重复失败的实验，追求不可行的想法。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了EvoScientist，这是一个不断发展的多代理AI科学家框架，通过持续的记忆和自我进化不断改进研究策略。 EvoScientist由三个专业代理组成：一个负责科学思想生成的研究人员代理(RA)，一个负责实验实施和执行的工程师代理(EA)，以及一个将先前的相互作用的洞察力转化为可重复使用的知识的进化管理代理(EMA)。 EvoScientist包含两个持久的内存模块：(一)一个想法记忆，它总结了顶级思想中可行的研究方向，同时记录了以前不成功的方向；(二)一个实验记忆，它捕捉了从代码搜索轨迹和最佳执行中衍生出来的有效的数据处理和模型培训策略。这些模块使RA和EA能够检索相关的前期战略，随着时间的推移提高思想质量和代码执行成功率。实验显示，EvoScientist在科学思想生成方面超越了7个开放源代码和商业先进系统，通过自动和人文评价实现了更高的新颖性，可行性，相关性和清晰度。 EvoScientist也通过多剂演化大幅提高代码执行成功率，证明了持续的记忆对端到端科学发现的有效性。

items.detail: Few-step diffusion or flow-based generative models typically distill a velocity-predicting teacher into a student that predicts a shortcut towards denoised data. This format mismatch has led to complex distillation procedures that often suffer from a quality-diversity trade-off. To address this, we propose policy-based flow models (pi-Flow). pi-Flow modifies the output layer of a student flow model to predict a network-free policy at one timestep. The policy then produces dynamic flow velocities at future substeps with negligible overhead, enabling fast and accurate ODE integration on these substeps without extra network evaluations. To match the policy's ODE trajectory to the teacher's, we introduce a novel imitation distillation approach, which matches the policy's velocity to the teacher's along the policy's trajectory using a standard ell_2 flow matching loss. By simply mimicking the teacher's behavior, pi-Flow enables stable and scalable training and avoids the quality-diversity trade-off. On ImageNet 256^2, it attains a 1-NFE FID of 2.85, outperforming MeanFlow of the same DiT architecture. On FLUX.1-12B and Qwen-Image-20B at 4 NFEs, pi-Flow achieves substantially better diversity than state-of-the-art few-step methods, while maintaining teacher-level quality.
items.title_zh: Pi-Flow：通过仿真稀释法实现基于政策的几步生成
items.detail_zh: 很少步骤的传播或基于流的基因模型一般会将一个速度预测的老师蒸馏成一个预言向去声化数据的捷径的学生。这种格式上的不匹配导致了复杂的蒸馏程序，往往受到质量多样性权衡的影响。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了基于政策的流动模式(pi-Flow)。 pi-Flow修改学生流模型的输出层，以预测一次无网络政策。然后，该政策在未来的分步骤产生动态流量速度，可忽略不计的间接费用，从而能够在不进行额外网络评价的情况下快速和准确地整合这些分步骤的ODE。为了将保单的ODE轨迹与老师的轨迹相匹配，我们引入了一种小说仿真蒸馏方法，这个方法将保单的速度与老师的轨迹相匹配，使用标准ell 2流量匹配损失。 Pi-Flow只是模仿教师的行为，就能够进行稳定和可扩展的培训，避免质量多样性的权衡。在ImageNet 256^2上，它获得了1.85的1-NFEFID，优于同一DiT架构的均价。在4 NFE的FLUX.1-12B和Quen-Image-20B上，pi-Flow在保持师资水平质量的同时，比最先进的几步方法，实现了大幅提高的多样性。

items.title: alibaba/open-code-review
items.subtitle: Secure, fast, efficient, battle-tested at Alibaba's scale. Hybrid architecture code review tool: deterministic pipelines + LLM Agent, precise line-level comments, built-in multi-language ruleset (NPE, thread-safety, XSS, SQL injection), OpenAI & Anthropic compatible.
items.detail: Open Code Review is an AI-powered code review CLI tool. It originated as Alibaba Group's internal official AI code review assistant — over the past two years, it has served tens of thousands of developers and identified millions of code defects. After thorough validation at massive scale, we incubated it into an open source project for the community. Simply configure a model endpoint to get started. It reads Git diffs, sends changed files to a configurable LLM via an agent with tool-use capabilities, and generates structured review comments with line-level precision. The agent can read full file contents, search the codebase, inspect other changed files for context, and produce deep reviews — not just surface-level diff feedback. Beyond diff review, ocr scan reviews entire files for auditing unfamiliar codebases or directories that have no meaningful diff. A real-world code review benchmark built from 50 popular open-source repositories, 200 real Pull Requests, and 10 programming languages — cross-validated by 80+ senior engineers (1,505 annotated ground-truth issues).
items.subtitle_zh: 安全，快速，高效，战斗测试 在阿里巴巴的规模。混合结构代码审查工具：确定式管道+LLM 代理，精确的行级注释，内置多语言规则(NPE，线程安全，XSS，SQL注入)，OpenAI & Anthropic兼容。
items.detail_zh: Open Code Review是一个AI驱动的代码审查CLI工具。它起源于阿里巴巴集团的内部官方AI代码审查助理——在过去两年里，它为数以万计的开发者服务，并查明了数百万的代码缺陷。经过大规模的彻底验证后，我们把它孵化成一个面向社区的开源项目。简单的配置模式端点开始。它读作Git diffs，通过具有工具使用能力的代理将更改的文件发送到可配置的LLM，并以行级精度生成结构化的评论。代理可以读取完整的文件内容，搜索代码库，检查其他更改的文件以了解上下文，并产生深层评论——而不仅仅是表层diff反馈。除了diff审查之外， ocr扫描会审查整个文件，以审计不熟悉的代码库或目录，没有有意义的diff。由50个受欢迎的开源寄存器、200个真实的Pull请求和10种编程语言组成的现实世界代码审查基准——80+高级工程师交叉验证(1 505个附加说明的地面真相问题)。

items.title: ag-ui-protocol/ag-ui
items.subtitle: AG-UI: the Agent-User Interaction Protocol. Bring Agents into Frontend Applications.
items.detail: AG-UI is an open, lightweight, event-based protocol that standardizes how AI agents connect to user-facing applications. Agents don't fit the request/response model. They stream tokens, call tools mid-response, update shared state, pause for a human, and spawn subagents, and every framework does it differently. AG-UI replaces that custom wiring with one bi-directional event stream: the agent emits typed events, and any client can render them, no matter which framework built the agent. The same agent can power a web app, a mobile app, a terminal, or Slack. Start a new app. The CLI scaffolds a frontend (CopilotKit on Next.js, or a terminal client) wired to the agent framework you pick:
items.subtitle_zh: AG-UI：代理用户互动协议。让代理进入前端应用程序。
items.detail_zh: AG-UI是一个开放的，轻量级的，基于事件的协议，它规范了AI代理与用户界面应用程序的连接。特工们不符合请求/回应模式。它们流出代号，调用工具 中响应，更新共享状态，暂停一个人类，和产卵子剂，每个框架都不同。 AG-UI用一个双向事件流取代了自定义的线程：代理发送了输入的事件，任何客户端都可以渲染它们，不管哪个框架构建了代理。同名代理可以为网络应用，移动应用，终端，或Slack提供动力。启动新应用程序。 CLI脚手架前端(CopilotKit on Next.js，或终端客户端)连接到您选择的代理框架:

items.title: meta/astryx
items.subtitle: An open source design system that's fully customizable and agent ready
items.detail: An open source design system that's fully customizable and built for how we build now: by people and the agents working alongside them. Astryx is an open source design system that grew inside Meta over the last eight years, where it became the most-used and largest design system in the company — powering 13,000+ apps and shaped by the engineers, designers, and product teams who depend on it every day. It ships 150+ accessible components, brand-level theming, dark mode, ready-to-ship templates, and a CLI as one cohesive system. You import pre-built CSS and use typed React components — no build plugin, no styling library to adopt — and both people and AI assistants build with the same tooling.

items.title: pookjw/HermesEnabler
items.subtitle: Enable Hermès Watch Faces on any Apple Watch devices
items.detail: English · Tiếng Việt · 한국어 · 简体中文 · 繁體中文 · 日本語 · Español · Français · Deutsch · Português On macOS you can install the prebuilt IPA with Sideloadly or build the app directly with Xcode. Either way, the iPhone must be paired with the target Apple Watch, and the Watch must run a supported watchOS version. 1. Download the IPA from Releases. 2. Install Sideloadly on your Mac, connect your iPhone with a cable, and select it in Sideloadly. 3. Drag the IPA into Sideloadly and enter your Apple ID. Turn off Use automatic bundle ID, set a fixed Bundle Identifier, and start signing. 4. On the iPhone, open Settings → General → VPN & Device Management and trust your developer certificate. 5. On the iPhone, open Settings → Privacy & Security → Developer Mode, turn it on, restart, and confirm. 6. On the iPhone, open the Watch app, go to My Watch → Apps, and install HermesEnabler2 on the Watch. 7. On the Apple Watch, open Settings → Privacy & Security → Developer Mode, turn it on, restart, and confirm. If the option is not shown, install the Watch app first and check again. 8. Open HermesEnabler2 on your Apple Watch and follow the steps in the app.
items.subtitle_zh: 在任何苹果监视设备上启用 Hermès 监视面孔

items.title: we-promise/sure

items.detail: The Maybe Finance (archived/abandoned repo) team spent most of 2021–2022 building a full-featured personal finance and wealth management app. It even included an “Ask an Advisor” feature that connected users with a real CFP/CFA — all included with your subscription. items.detail: Oil UI is an interface design skill for AI agents. It explores a few genuinely different design directions side by side, lets you choose one, then refines it against real screenshots. It works for websites, apps, dashboards, and components. See more designs at ui.oiloil.org. 1. Understand what the product is. Before drawing anything, it names the product category, finds two or three peers with the most distinctive styles, and looks at what they do and why. Then it decides what to keep and what to change. 2. Turn “premium” and “clean” into real decisions. Everyone uses these words, but they don't tell you what to put on the screen. It first sets the tone from the subject, audience, and brand voice, such as lively or calm, polished or raw, dense or airy. Then it turns that tone into visible choices: which typefaces, how much white space, and how much of the page uses color. 3. Start each direction from something concrete. That could be a material in its setting, a scene, a character, or the visual language of another field. Ideas come from the product itself, not from adjectives like “minimal” or “bold.” 4. Decide who the first screen is for. On pages where people browse, shop, or get work done, the first screen should be the content itself. items.detail: One prompt in, a finished short video out, using only open-weights models on your own ComfyUI. open-higgsfield-skills is an agent-agnostic pack of 37 Agent Skills that teaches any coding agent (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, Hermes, Pi or your own) to work as a film crew. The video-director skill takes a one-line idea such as "a lighthouse keeper finds a message in a bottle" and breaks it into a story bible, a shot list, keyframes, video shots, voice, music, captions and a final cut. It sends every step to ComfyUI workflows built on open weights: FLUX Klein, LTX-2.x, Qwen-Image-Edit, Wan, SeedVR2, ACE-Step, Chatterbox, Whisper and more. Every shot in the demo video was rendered by this pack from one manifest. video-director validated and packaged it, and google-colab-runner ran it as a single notebook on a Google Colab RTX PRO 6000 (96 GB, standard tier). All 14 jobs finished in about 8.5 compute units, including setup and the roughly 99 GB model download. The narration was also generated by the pack.

items.detail: OpenBUA was asked to "Find me 2 students from Australia using Linkedin and email them selling my app Petedoro" OpenBUA (Open Browser Use Agent) is an open-source, autonomous AI browser agent built as a Chrome Extension (Manifest V3) that runs directly inside your everyday browser. Unlike cloud browser-use tools that require spun-up headless containers, login bypass proxies, or remote servers, OpenBUA operates right inside your existing browser session with all your active cookies, credentials, and logins already available. Built with @earendil-works/pi-agent-core and @earendil-works/pi-ai, OpenBUA equips AI models with real-time DOM perception, intelligent multi-step navigation, synthetic event form-filling, incremental live research previews, and a self-learning memory system.

items.title: DingyangLyu/MatOS
items.subtitle: MatOS: an agent operating system for materials research, with a layered scientific asset graph, stateful adaptive workflows and evidence-driven asset evolution.
items.author: TypeScript
items.detail: Describe a materials research task. MatOS assembles the scientific assets it needs, runs them as a stateful, checkable workflow, and turns every run into better assets for the next one. MatOS is an agent operating system for materials research. Materials studies run for days, cross literature, computation and experiment, and keep changing as results arrive. Agents for this work have to take on new data and software, keep long tasks on track, and remember what earlier tasks taught them. MatOS builds these capabilities around versioned scientific assets: data, knowledge, tools, skills, roles and workflows. Research tasks drive the stateful adaptive workflow, the layered scientific asset graph supplies composable capabilities, and execution traces and user feedback become reviewed asset revisions that return to the graph.
items.subtitle_zh: MatOS：用于材料研究的代理操作系统，具有分层的科学资产图，状态适应性工作流程和证据驱动的资产演化。
items.detail_zh: 描述一项材料研究任务。 MatOS将它所需要的科学资产组装起来，把它们运行为一个状态的，可核查的工作流程，并将每一次运行变为下一个更好的资产。 MatOS是一个用于材料研究的代理操作系统。材料研究持续数日，交叉文献，计算和实验，并随着结果的到来不断改变。这项工作的代理人必须掌握新的数据和软件，使长期任务走上正轨，并记住以前的任务教给他们什么。 MatOS围绕版本化的科学资产建立这些能力：数据，知识，工具，技能，角色和工作流程。研究任务驱动了状态适应性工作流程，分层的科学资产图提供了可混杂的能力，执行痕迹和用户反馈成为了经过审查的资产修订，回到图中。

items.title: Nbill27/academic-writing-skills
items.subtitle: General Indonesian academic writing skills for AI agents: outline, draft, edit, and audit research theses, journal articles, internship reports, and technical reports, with a workflow dispatcher and campus-guide adapter.
items.author: Python
items.detail: General Indonesian academic writing skills, not tied to one campus. Five skills carry a document from outline to submission: a dispatcher routes the task, then outline builds the frame, draft writes the sections, edit fixes the language, and audit checks the result. They cover research theses, journal articles, internship reports, and technical reports. Campus rules are variables, not hardcoded text. The audit also examines the internal logic of the research, cross-section consistency, methodology fit, and claim-evidence alignment—not only campus-guideline compliance. Give the skill a guide file and it adapts. Without a guide it uses common Indonesian defaults and marks every uncertain rule [CHECK: campus guide]. Plain Agent Skills format: each skill is a folder with a SKILL.md at its root, so any agent that reads that format can use them. Each skill folder also holds a references/ directory with the deep material the skill loads on demand, for example skills/outline/references/guide-adapter.md or skills/edit/references/ai-patterns.md.
items.subtitle_zh: 印度尼西亚通用AI代理的学术写作技能：概述、起草、编辑和审计研究论文、期刊文章、实习报告和技术报告，配有工作流程调度员和校园指导适配器。
items.detail_zh: 印尼一般学术写作技能，不与一个校园挂钩。 5个技能从大纲到提交都携带一个文件：一个调度员路过任务，然后大纲构建框架，起草章节，编辑修改语言，审计检查结果。它们包括研究论文、期刊文章、实习报告和技术报告。校园规则是变量，而不是硬编码文本。审计还审查了研究的内部逻辑、跨部门一致性、方法是否合适以及索赔证据是否一致——不仅仅是校园准则是否得到遵守。给技能一个向导文件，它可以适应。没有指南，它使用印度尼西亚常见的默认，并标记每个不确定的规则[CHECK：校园指南]。 Plain Agent Swills格式：每个技能都是一个以SKILL.md为根的文件夹，因此任何读取该格式的代理都可以使用。每个技能文件夹还设有一个参考文献/目录，其中包含所需技能负荷的深度材料，例如技能/外线/参考文献/指南-适应器。md或技能/编辑/参考文献/ai-patterns.md。
